We're looking for a highly motivated and multi-talented Virtual Assistant to join our growing group homes business on a part-time basis. You'll be the driving force behind our business development, marketing, and operational initiatives—helping us scale our capacity and reach the right clients. This is a hands-on role where you'll wear multiple hats and help us build systems from the ground up.



IMPORTANT: Since this role involves phone outreach, we require all applicants to submit a short voice recording (1-2 minutes) along with their application so we can hear how you communicate over the phone. Instructions are included in the "How to Apply" section below.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Development & Lead Generation



Conduct cold calling campaigns to identify and engage potential referral sources

Send outreach
s to build relationships with key stakeholders and referral partners

Use Apollo to research and scrape domain/contact information for targeted outreach

Create and implement a follow-up system to nurture leads through the sales pipeline

Track and report on lead generation metrics and conversion rates



Marketing & Content Creation



Develop a cohesive brand kit in Canva (including logos, color palettes, fonts, templates)

Design and create marketing flyers, social media graphics, and promotional content

Manage our
 Business Page (posting, engagement, community management)

Manage our LinkedIn page (posting industry insights, updates, engagement)

Develop social media strategy to attract our target audience (group home operators, families, referral partners)

Create engaging content that drives engagement and attracts referral sources



Website & Digital Presence



Implement strategies to improve website SEO and increase organic traffic

Monitor click-through rates and traffic metrics

Collaborate on optimizing website content for lead generation

Manage digital files and ensure proper organization of all web assets



Documentation & Administrative Systems



Manage digital files and organize onboarding documentation

Upload and create documents in JotForm, Adobe, and/or DocuSign

Develop standardized templates for common documents

Help establish and organize file management systems

Assist with creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) as systems are being developed



Operational Support



Be flexible and adaptable—we're still building out our systems, so you'll work collaboratively as we establish processes

Help identify inefficiencies and suggest solutions

Contribute ideas for improving workflows and operations

Support the owner in any additional tasks needed to fill beds and grow the business



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant or in a similar business development/marketing role

Strong communication skills - both written and verbal

Experience with cold calling and
 outreach (B2B or business development background preferred)

Proficiency in: Canva, social media management platforms, Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, document management systems, Apollo (or willingness to learn), JotForm, Adobe, or DocuSign

Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

Problem-solving mindset - able to work in a developing environment and help create solutions

Familiarity with
 Business Manager and 
 is a plus

Basic SEO knowledge or willingness to learn



IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE



Detail-oriented and organized

Proactive and solution-focused

Comfortable with technology and quick to learn new tools

Energetic and enthusiastic about supporting business growth

Able to prioritize and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Experience in healthcare, social services, or related fields is a plus

Eager to grow with a scaling business and take ownership of projects



WORK ENVIRONMENT



Fully Remote - work from anywhere in the Philippines

Growing Company - we're actively building out our systems and processes

Collaborative - you'll work closely with the business owner to develop solutions

Flexible - you'll need to adapt as we establish new processes and SOPs

Impactful - your work directly contributes to helping families access quality group home services



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This isn't a position where everything is perfectly structured—and that's the opportunity! We're looking for someone who:



Thrives in dynamic environments

Can help us build scalable, organized systems

Takes initiative and doesn't wait to be told what to do

Provides feedback and ideas for improvement

Is energized by the challenge of building a business from the ground up



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Time Zone: This position requires working on Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours — no exceptions. Please only apply if you are able to commit to working EST hours consistently.

title: 3D CAD Industrial & Product Designer Organic Modeling & Surface Design
description:
CUTLERY & KNIFE INDUSTRY

We are seeking an experienced 3D CAD Industrial & Product Designer to join our cutlery brand, specializing in commercial consumer product design, organic modeling, advanced surface design, and product development.

The ideal candidate must combine advanced technical 3D CAD expertise with a strong sense of industrial design, aesthetics, and product design language. We are looking for a creative professional capable of developing visually appealing, distinctive, and commercially successful consumer products while ensuring technical precision and manufacturing feasibility.

Product design skills, aesthetic judgment, and the ability to create a coherent design language are equally important as technical 3D CAD proficiency. We are seeking a designer, not solely a mechanical engineer or CAD technician.

Requirements

•  Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in 3D CAD, industrial design, and consumer product development.

•  Commercial Consumer Product Design (Mandatory): Proven experience designing complete consumer products intended for commercial production and retail markets, combining functionality, ergonomics, aesthetics, and market appeal.

•  Industrial Design & Design Language (Mandatory): Strong aesthetic judgment and understanding of product proportions, visual balance, form development, styling, and brand identity. Ability to create distinctive, visually cohesive products with a recognizable design language.

•  Advanced 3D CAD Modeling: Expertise in organic shapes, complex surface modeling, geometric textures, and detailed 3D product development.

•  Parametric 3D CAD Design: Strong proficiency in parametric 3D CAD modeling, including feature-based design, design history, assemblies, and fully editable solid and surface geometries.

•  Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Strong understanding of manufacturing techniques, particularly laser cutting, CNC milling, and machining processes.

•  Technical 3D CAD Files: Proficiency in creating, managing, and delivering high-quality, production-ready STEP/STP files with accurate solid and surface geometry.

•  Product Development: Proven ability to conceptualize, design, engineer, and prototype complete consumer products, from initial design concepts and aesthetic development to manufacturing-ready 3D CAD models.

•  Portfolio (Mandatory): A professional portfolio demonstrating both technical 3D CAD capabilities and strong industrial design skills, including aesthetically refined consumer products. Portfolios consisting exclusively of mechanical components or engineering assemblies will not be sufficient.

•  Language: Fluency in English is mandatory, with strong communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

•  Relevant Industry Experience: Previous experience in cutlery, knife design, or knifemaking is highly valued. Alternatively, a strong background in designing high-end consumer products, with demonstrated attention to aesthetics, premium finishes, sophisticated geometries, and refined product design language, is equally desirable.

•   Proficiency in SolidWorks and/or CATIA.

•   Experience developing complex surface textures and ergonomic product geometries.

•   Experience establishing consistent product design languages across product families or collections.

•   Familiarity with prototyping, material selection, and production optimization.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented 3D CAD Industrial & Product Designer who combines advanced parametric modeling expertise with a refined sense of aesthetics, proportions, ergonomics, and contemporary consumer product design.

The ability to create attractive, distinctive, commercially viable products is just as important as the ability to engineer and manufacture them. The ideal candidate must demonstrate both strong technical execution and genuine industrial design creativity, translating innovative concepts into visually compelling, functional, and production-ready products.

title: Shopify eCommerce Growth & Development Manager | Hands-On Store Ownership | Remote
description:
**Job Type:** Part-time initially, with potential for long-term growth\

**Location:** Remote\

**Industry:** Australian eCommerce / Online Retail



## About the Role



We are an Australian company managing and developing multiple eCommerce brands. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on **Shopify eCommerce Growth & Development Manager** who can take ownership of developing, improving, and growing our online stores.



**This is NOT a routine Shopify Store Administrator, Product Listing VA, or Order Management position.**



We need someone who understands how to build and develop an eCommerce business, not simply maintain its daily operations.



Your main responsibility will be to identify opportunities, plan improvements, and personally implement changes that enhance our Shopify stores, improve the customer journey, increase conversions, and support sustainable business growth.



You should be comfortable working both strategically and practically. We are not looking for someone who only prepares plans and delegates tasks. You must be capable of executing a significant portion of the work yourself.



Initially, the role will focus heavily on Shopify website development, store improvements, and conversion optimisation. Over time, responsibilities may expand into social media, digital marketing, brand development, and other growth initiatives.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Shopify Store Development & Improvement (Primary Focus)**



- Take ownership of ongoing Shopify store development and improvement projects.

- Review existing stores, identify weaknesses, and recommend practical solutions.

- Improve homepage layouts, product pages, collections, navigation, menus, and overall website structure.

- Implement Shopify theme customisations, app configurations, and website enhancements.

- Develop new landing pages, promotional pages, product launches, and conversion-focused content.

- Coordinate with developers or designers for more technical tasks when required.



**2. Customer Journey & Conversion Optimisation**



- Analyse the complete customer journey, from first website visit through checkout.

- Identify friction points affecting customer experience, trust, and purchasing decisions.

- Improve product presentation, calls to action, mobile experience, and checkout flow.

- Recommend and implement improvements to increase conversion rates and average order value.

- Review competitor websites and introduce relevant improvements and best practices.

- Use Shopify Analytics, GA4, heatmaps, and other tools to identify improvement opportunities.

 marketing, and customer retention strategies.

 marketing

## How to Apply

title: Technical Digital Marketer
description:
Technical Digital Marketer

Level 5 Mentoring

Full-time  ·  Remote  ·  Dedicated role

Retainer: $3,000/month USD



We’re a multiple 7-figure coaching and personal development company with an active launch calendar and evergreen funnels running daily. We’re hiring a technical digital marketer to join our marketing team and take ownership of the build side — funnels, automations, pages, and integrations.

This person reports to our Funnel Strategist and works closely with the marketing and exec teams.



No agencies.



Apply here:  





The Day-to-Day

Build, maintain, and improve evergreen funnels

Build and run challenge and webinar funnels for launches

Build high-ticket funnels, including application and booking flows

Design funnel pages, layouts, and graphics that look good on any device

Set up and manage Deadline Funnel campaigns, timers, and expiring offers

Build
 and SMS automations, pipelines, tags, and workflows

Connect tools with Zapier and fix integrations when they break

Work in GoHighLevel and Ontraport every day

Manage your tasks and timelines in ClickUp

Use Claude (AI) daily to write, build, check, and troubleshoot faster

Test every funnel end to end — desktop and mobile — before it goes live

Attend team meetings and report on what you’ve built, what’s live, and what’s broken



Required Tech Skills

GoHighLevel

At least 3 years of hands-on experience. You can build funnels, workflows, pipelines, calendars, forms, custom fields, and triggers without help.

Ontraport

Full working knowledge of campaigns, automations, tags, forms, and order forms.

Claude (AI)

A strong working understanding. You already use it in your day-to-day for copy, builds, QA, and problem-solving.

Deadline Funnel

Experience setting up evergreen deadlines and connecting them to GHL and Ontraport.

Zapier

You can build multi-step zaps, use filters and paths, and debug a failed zap.

ClickUp

You can manage tasks, timelines, and checklists, and keep a team on schedule.



Required Design and Funnel Skills

Graphic design

You can create page graphics, banners, mockups, slides, and social images. Tell us which tools you use (Canva, Figma, Photoshop, or others).

Funnel design and layout

You know how to lay out an opt-in page, sales page, order form, and thank-you page so the page is easy to read and the next step is obvious.

Mobile responsiveness

Every page you build works on a phone. You check spacing, font sizes, images, buttons, and forms on mobile before anything goes live.

Offers

You understand how offers are built (core offer, bonuses, order bumps, upsells, downsells, pricing, and guarantees) and how each one is placed in the funnel.

Full funnel experience

You’ve built complete funnels from traffic and opt-in through to the sale, onboarding, and follow-up. You understand how each step affects the next one.

Online launches

A deep understanding of how launches run, from pre-launch and registration through live events, cart open, cart close, and follow-up.

Funnel types

Proven experience with evergreen, webinar, challenge, and high-ticket funnels.



What We Need to See

Applications without examples will not be reviewed.



1. Challenge launches you’ve built or run, with links or screen recordings

2. Webinar launches you’ve built or run

3. Evergreen funnels you’ve built

4. High-ticket funnels you’ve built

5. Automations you’ve built (screenshots or a Loom walkthrough of the workflow)

6. Design samples — funnel pages, graphics, or mockups you designed yourself

7. At least one funnel we can open on a phone so we can check the mobile version

8. A short note on your GHL experience: how many years, and what you’ve built in it

Best way to show us: A 3–5 minute Loom walking us through one full funnel, from opt-in to sale.



Hours, Availability, and What to Expect

This is a full-time, dedicated role — sometimes more during launches.

We run launches often, and launches regularly require weekend work. The evergreen funnels run every day, so problems can come up on any day of the week.

A few things to know upfront:

The pace is fast. We are actively scaling and building, and this role will be busy from day one.

We value people who can think through problems themselves, bring ideas to meetings, and take initiative — not just follow a task list.

You will be a key part of a small, committed team. Your work directly affects whether campaigns succeed.



Ready to apply?

title: Experienced Media Buyer
description:
FULL-TIME GOOGLE ADS /
 ADS MANAGER / MEDIA BUYER



Performance Marketing | Paid Advertising | Lead Generation



We are looking for a highly driven, analytical, and results-focused Media Buyer to join our team full-time.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that successful paid advertising is about more than simply launching campaigns. You should enjoy testing, analysing data, identifying opportunities, and continuously optimising campaigns to improve results.



You will be responsible for managing and 
 paid advertising campaigns across
, Instagram, and Google, with the ultimate goal of turning cold and warm traffic into leads, subscribers, community members, customers, and sales.



This is a full-time position working Monday to Friday during Australian business hours. It is not suitable for candidates looking for part-time, freelance, or gig work.



ABOUT THE ROLE



As our Media Buyer, you will take ownership of the performance of paid advertising campaigns across multiple accounts.



You will work closely with our creative, content, development, and marketing teams to ensure campaigns are properly set up, tracked, tested, and continuously improved.



You will not be responsible for writing ad copy, designing graphics, or editing videos.



Instead, your focus will be on understanding what converts, testing different creative and audience combinations, analysing performance, and making data-driven decisions to improve campaign results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Campaign Management & Optimisation



Manage and 
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Scale campaigns that are performing well while identifying and addressing underperforming campaigns.



Optimise campaigns to improve conversion rates and overall return on advertising spend.



Monitor budgets and ensure advertising spend is being allocated effectively.



Identify trends, performance issues, and opportunities before they become major problems.



Testing & Performance

Test different creative assets and variations.



Test different audiences and targeting strategies.



Test different campaign structures and approaches.



Identify winning combinations and scale them.



Quickly recognise what is not working and make changes.



Use campaign data to continuously improve performance.



Develop and communicate clear testing hypotheses.



Tracking & Conversion



Work with developers to establish appropriate tracking for each account.

Ensure campaigns are accurately measuring the desired conversion events.



Monitor tracking and identify potential issues or inconsistencies.



Ensure campaign data is reliable enough to support optimisation decisions.



Help ensure the customer journey is properly tracked from advertisement through to conversion.



Funnel & Campaign Congruency



Ensure consistency between advertisements, landing pages, offers, and the overall customer journey.



Identify gaps or inconsistencies that may negatively affect conversion rates.



Work with the broader marketing team to improve the relationship between traffic, landing pages, content, and offers.



Understand the difference between generating traffic and generating qualified conversions.



Lead Generation & Conversion



Depending on the account, campaigns may be designed to convert cold and warm traffic into:



Subscribers



Leads containing name,
, and phone number



 Group members



Customers



Sales



Other defined conversion actions



Your responsibility is to help turn paid traffic into measurable business outcomes, not simply clicks or impressions.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this role means becoming someone the team can rely on to consistently improve advertising performance through testing, analysis, and optimisation.



In your first 30–60 days, success looks like:



You understand our accounts, campaigns, audiences, funnels, offers, and conversion goals.



Campaigns are properly structured and monitored.



Tracking and conversion events are working correctly.



You can confidently identify campaign performance issues and opportunities.

You can clearly explain why you are making specific optimisation decisions.



As you become established in the role, success looks like:



Campaign performance is continuously improving.



You consistently identify and scale winning campaigns and creative.



Poor-performing campaigns are identified and addressed quickly.



You develop a strong understanding of what works for different audiences and offers.



Cost per lead, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, and other relevant KPIs are actively managed.



Advertising budgets are allocated based on performance and opportunity.



Tracking issues are identified and resolved quickly.



You contribute meaningful insights and recommendations to the wider marketing team.



Ultimately, success means:



You can take responsibility for paid traffic performance and demonstrate that your work is generating measurable results for our clients and the business.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply manage ads — we want someone who thinks like a performance marketer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential



2+ years of proven hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns.



Strong experience with
 Ads and Instagram Ads.



Experience with Google Ads.



Demonstrated experience managing and optimising campaigns based on performance data.



Strong understanding of paid advertising and lead generation.



Experience with conversion tracking and campaign tracking.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong attention to detail.



Ability to work independently and take ownership of campaign performance.



Fast and reliable internet connection.



Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Ability to work full-time Monday to Friday during Australian business hours.



We especially value people who:

Don't become emotionally attached to campaigns or creative that isn't working.



Are proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.



Can identify problems and propose solutions.



Are comfortable managing multiple campaigns/accounts.

Are constantly looking for ways to improve performance.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...

 or Google Ads.

WORKING HOURS



Full-Time



Monday to Friday

Australian business hours



You must be available to work consistently during the required Australian business hours.



HOW TO APPLY



If you are an experienced Media Buyer who loves testing, optimisation, data, and getting measurable results, we would love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE BUSINESS:

We work with a specialist team of media buyers, graphic designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and marketing professionals to deliver high-performing campaigns for our clients.



 ABOUT THE ROLE:



We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Coordinator to take ownership of coordinating client marketing campaigns from planning through to launch.



You will work closely with clients and our internal delivery team to ensure campaigns are strategically aligned, delivered on time, high quality, and ready to perform.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



Campaign Management



* Plan and coordinate multiple marketing and lead generation campaigns from concept through to launch.

* Manage timelines, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies.

* Coordinate clients, media buyers, designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and other specialists.

* Ensure everyone understands what needs to be delivered and when.



 Campaign Strategy & Quality Control



* Identify the #1 pain point the campaign is solving and ensure it is relevant to the target audience.

* Ensure consistent messaging across the entire customer journey, including **ads, creative, landing pages, lead magnets, funnels,
s, and calls to action**.

* Review campaign assets and identify gaps, errors, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

* Ensure campaigns are as strong as possible before going live.



Content & Optimisation



* Review, rewrite, and optimise ad copy, landing page copy, funnel copy,
 copy, headlines, and calls to action** when required.

Problem Solving & Launch



* Identify roadblocks, missing information, risks, and issues early.

* Proactively solve problems and escalate issues when necessary.

* Conduct final campaign checks before launch.

* Organise and document all campaign assets and information.

* Provide a clear handover to the Media Buyer for post-launch management and optimisation.



SOFTWARE & TOOLS



You will use:



*GHL— CRM

*Zoom — Meetings & client communication

*Loom— Screen recordings

*Slack— Team communication

*ClickUp— Project management

*Gmail —

*Google Drive— File management

*Google Sheets — Tracking & reporting



Experience with these tools is an advantage, but we can provide training.



REQUIREMENTS



This role is ideal for someone who:



* Has 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, campaign coordination, project management, lead generation, or a similar role.

* Understands paid digital advertising and lead generation.

* Is highly organised and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Can confidently communicate with clients and internal team members.

* Has strong problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership abilities.

* Is proactive and takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Has excellent attention to detail and a results-driven mindset.

* Enjoys working with creative, marketing, and technical specialists.

* Is eager to learn, improve, and take on greater responsibility.



The Type of person we're looking for:



We are looking for someone who:



*Thinks ahead.

*Takes ownership.

*Spots problems early.

*Solves problems proactively.

*Communicates clearly.

*Pays attention to detail.

*Works well with others.

*Wants to learn and improve.



You don't need to know everything on Day 1. We will train you on our systems and processes.

What we do need is someone with the attitude, initiative, and work ethic to become exceptional at the role.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You will be successful when:



* Campaigns launch on time with minimal delays or last-minute issues.

* Projects are organised and everyone knows what they are responsible for.

* Campaigns are high quality with strong and consistent messaging across every touchpoint.

* Problems are identified early and resolved proactively rather than becoming larger issues.

* Clients are well communicated with and feel confident that their campaigns are being managed professionally.

* Team members have what they need to complete their work efficiently.

* Campaign handovers are complete and organised allowing Media Buyers to take over smoothly.

* You require progressively less supervision because you understand what needs to be done and take initiative.

* Ultimately, the campaigns you coordinate contribute to quality leads, sales, and measurable growth for our clients.**



The ultimate measure of success:



*Clients are happy.

*Campaigns launch on time.

*The work is high quality.

*The team is organised.

*Problems are solved before they become problems.

*Our campaigns generate results.**







HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your **CV/resume and cover letter** explaining:

Remote | 20 Hours/Week | US Business Hours

Optemate is a Pennsylvania-based web development and AI automation company. We give local service businesses (HVAC, auto repair, contractors, gyms, home services) a professionally built demo website for free. If the owner likes it, they pay $100/month to keep it live. If not, they owe nothing.



It’s a simple offer that’s easy to explain and easy to book.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Call business owners from qualified lead lists we provide. No prospecting needed.

Pitch the free demo website and book short demo calls on our team’s calendar.

Log calls in our tracker and hit 100+ dials per shift.



Our team handles the demos, closing, and any upsells like SEO, Google Business Profile, and automations. We provide a US calling number, lead lists, and call scripts.



SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday, 9 AM–1 PM US Eastern (20 hours/week). Fixed, not rotating.

In Philippine time, that’s 10 PM–2 AM during US standard time and 9 PM–1 AM during US daylight saving time.



These are the hours US business owners are most likely to answer.



PAY

$450/month base, paid twice monthly ($225 per payment) via Wise.

$8 per attended demo. The owner must join the call and stay at least 5 minutes. You earn it whether or not they buy.

$100 per new client, paid once their first payment clears. This applies to any client who signs within 30 days of a demo you booked.

$250 bonus every time 10 of your booked demos become paying clients.



Commissions are paid on the next pay date. Base pay starts on day one, including the two-week trial. Trial targets are 100+ dials per shift and 5 demos booked by the end of week two.



EXAMPLE MONTHLY EARNINGS

Performance Attended Demos Clients Monthly Earnings

Getting started 10 2 $730

Solid 15 4 $970

GROWTH



We review performance at 90 days. Callers who consistently hit targets and convert demos move toward full-time hours and a higher base. We’re looking for a long-term working relationship.



REQUIREMENTS

At least 1 year of cold calling, appointment setting, or outbound sales to US businesses.

Stable internet (25+ Mbps), a quiet workspace, and a headset with a microphone.

Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail, and calendar tools. CRM experience is a plus.

Comfortable hearing “no” dozens of times per shift while staying friendly and professional.

HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip these steps won’t be considered.



Start your message with DEMO.

Attach a 30-60 second voice recording (MP3, M4A, or Vocaroo link) pitching our free demo website to an HVAC business owner.

Include a screenshot of your internet speed from speedtest.net.

title: Senior U.S. Tax Accountant – Tax Planning & Financial Project Lead
description:
# Senior U.S. Tax Accountant — Tax Planning & Financial Project Lead



**Location:** Philippines (Remote)  

**Employment:** Part-Time / Project-Based, with Long-Term Potential  

**Compensation:** $18–$30 USD/hour, depending on qualifications and experience  

**Initial Engagement:** Paid assessment followed by a 30-day project, approximately 20–40 hours  

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some overlap during U.S. Pacific business hours



## About the Opportunity



I am a U.S.-based entrepreneur building a portfolio of businesses, including a scalable digital lead-generation company.



I am looking for an experienced **U.S. tax and accounting professional** who can help me understand my financial position, evaluate tax-planning opportunities, coordinate qualified specialists, and manage the execution of financial and tax-related projects.



**This is not a general virtual assistant, basic bookkeeping, or routine tax-data-entry position.**



I already have operational assistants who can support research, recruitment, scheduling, documentation, and administrative coordination.



What I need is someone with strong **financial and U.S. tax-domain expertise**, analytical judgment, initiative, and the ability to take ownership of complex projects.



The ideal candidate understands not only how tax returns are prepared but also how tax-planning decisions are evaluated, researched, documented, and implemented.



You do not need to be an expert in every area of taxation. However, you must understand your professional limitations and know when to involve qualified specialists.



## Primary Responsibilities



### 1. Financial Assessment & Tax Planning



- Help establish a clear picture of my personal and business finances.

- Review income, expenses, financial statements, and tax-related records.

- Identify missing information, potential deductions, and tax-planning opportunities.

- Assist with tax projections and comparisons of alternative strategies.

- Research relevant U.S. federal and state tax rules.

- Prepare clear financial summaries and actionable recommendations.

- Coordinate the preparation of complete, accountant-ready documentation.



### 2. Tax Strategy Research & Evaluation



Help investigate and evaluate strategies involving:



- Sole proprietorships, LLCs, S-Corps, and C-Corps

- Business deductions and tax credits

- Retirement accounts, Solo 401(k), and Roth strategies

- ROBS (Rollovers as Business Startups)

- Business ownership and holding structures

- California tax residency and international relocation

- Asset protection and trust structures

- Long-term business and financial planning



You are not expected to provide independent legal opinions or specialized advice outside your qualifications.



Your responsibility is to identify relevant opportunities, research the applicable rules, recognize risks, and coordinate qualified professional review when necessary.



### 3. Financial Project Leadership



- Take ownership of assigned financial and tax projects.

- Identify objectives, dependencies, missing information, and priorities.

- Develop practical implementation plans.

- Identify and help evaluate qualified CPAs, tax attorneys, retirement-plan specialists, and other advisers.

- Coordinate consultations and professional engagements.

- Evaluate proposals, recommendations, and implementation requirements.

- Track deadlines, deliverables, and unresolved issues.

- Ensure approved work progresses toward completion.



Existing administrative assistants can support routine coordination and execution.



**The goal is to minimize the business owner's involvement in day-to-day project management while maintaining appropriate professional oversight and approval.**



### 4. Financial Research & Communication



- Research complex financial and tax questions using authoritative sources.

- Compare alternatives and explain their advantages, disadvantages, costs, and risks.

- Distinguish verified facts from assumptions.

- Identify questionable claims or incomplete recommendations.

- Present findings in concise, well-organized written reports.

- Escalate important decisions rather than making unsupported assumptions.



AI-assisted research and workflow tools are welcome, provided information is verified and confidential data is handled appropriately.



## Required Qualifications



- Approximately 4+ years of substantial hands-on U.S. tax/accounting experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability.

- Strong understanding of U.S. individual and small-business taxation.

- Experience with Form 1040, Schedule C, and business tax returns.

- Experience preparing or reviewing tax workpapers and financial statements.

- Demonstrated experience with tax projections, tax research, or tax-planning support.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to independently identify problems and recommend next steps.

- Excellent written English communication.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Experience working with U.S. accounting firms or U.S. clients.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Active IRS Enrolled Agent or U.S. CPA credential.

- Philippine CPA qualification with substantial U.S. tax experience.

- Previous experience as a Senior U.S. Tax Accountant, Tax Advisory Associate, Tax Manager, or Tax Engagement Manager.

- Experience supporting tax-planning and advisory engagements.

- Familiarity with California taxation.

- Exposure to retirement plans, entity structuring, or international taxation.

- Experience coordinating multiple accounting or legal specialists.

- Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and professional U.S. tax software.

- Experience using AI tools responsibly for financial research and workflow improvement.



Professional credentials must be accurately identified by jurisdiction and current status.



## The Ideal Candidate



I am particularly interested in someone who:



- Thinks beyond routine tax preparation.

- Understands the broader financial implications of tax decisions.

- Can recognize important opportunities and risks.

- Takes initiative without requiring constant instructions.

- Can challenge assumptions respectfully and constructively.

- Knows when to research an issue and when to consult a specialist.

- Can coordinate people with different areas of expertise.

- Takes responsibility for producing useful outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

- Communicates clearly and concisely.



**I value sound judgment, integrity, and independent thinking more than impressive titles or polished presentations.**



## Initial Engagement & Long-Term Opportunity



The position will begin with a paid assessment and a defined 30-day project.



The initial work will focus on organizing financial information, evaluating tax-planning priorities, coordinating relevant professionals, and establishing a practical implementation roadmap.



Depending on performance and business needs, the role may expand into ongoing tax coordination, financial operations, business reporting, and strategic financial projects.



This is an opportunity to develop a meaningful long-term professional relationship with an entrepreneur building scalable businesses.



However, there is no expectation that you must commit to full-time work initially.



## Application Instructions — Please Read Carefully



To demonstrate that you have reviewed the complete job description, **begin your application with this exact heading:**



**Tax Advisory — Application**



Then provide the following:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your U.S. tax/accounting experience.

2. The types of U.S. tax returns you have personally prepared versus reviewed.

3. One example of a tax-planning or advisory project where you contributed meaningful analysis.

4. One example of a project you independently managed or helped bring to completion.

5. Your professional credentials, tax software experience, hourly rate, and weekly availability.



### Required Technical Question



Please answer the following in approximately 100–150 words:



*A California sole proprietor has approximately $140,000 in annual business income, $100,000 in cash, and no existing retirement accounts. They want to reduce current-year taxes and are considering funding a retirement plan and potentially using ROBS to invest in a new business.*



**What are the first three things you would investigate, and why?**



We are evaluating your reasoning, ability to identify missing information, understanding of tax-planning priorities, and recognition of when specialized professional advice is required.



We are not looking for promises of a particular tax outcome.



### Optional Video Introduction — Preferred



You are welcome to include a short **2–3 minute video introduction** using Loom, Zoom, or your phone.



Please briefly explain:



1. Your professional background in U.S. taxation and accounting.

2. A tax-planning or advisory project where you personally contributed meaningful work.

3. Why you believe you would be effective at independently managing a financial project involving multiple specialists.



A simple recording is sufficient. Professional editing is unnecessary.



**Video introductions are preferred but not required.** Equivalent written responses are welcome.



We are interested in your expertise, reasoning, and communication—not video production quality.



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to:



1. A written application review.

2. A short technical discussion.

3. A paid practical assessment using fictional financial data.

4. A final discussion regarding responsibilities, compensation, and availability.



The assessment will evaluate technical reasoning, financial accuracy, research quality, professional judgment, and project ownership.



Please do not submit confidential client records.



**If you have strong U.S. tax expertise, enjoy solving complex financial problems, and are capable of taking ownership of meaningful projects, I would be interested in hearing from you.**

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Senior Next.js Developer (AI/LLM) — Project-Based, Paid Per Feature — Work Health & Safety SaaS Platform
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Next.js Developer with strong, hands-on AI experience to deliver features on a project basis for a production-grade, multi-tenant SaaS platform for work health and safety compliance management, used by Australian businesses in construction, warehousing and manufacturing.



Work is delivered feature by feature, ticket by ticket. Each ticket has a clear scope, acceptance criteria and a fixed price agreed before you start. There is an ongoing pipeline of work for the right developer. This is not a beginner role.



How We Work



Work is issued as Jira tickets with Figma designs and acceptance criteria

You quote or accept a fixed price per ticket before starting

You deliver via pull request to a preview environment

Our lead developer reviews the code; once accepted, the ticket is paid

Payment via OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay



What You Will Do



AI Feature Development — Design, build and ship production-ready AI features (e.g. document and policy drafting, risk assessment assistance, inspection and hazard analysis, smart search across procedures, compliance insights and reporting)

LLM Integration — Work with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI or similar), including prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and streaming responses

RAG & Search — Build retrieval pipelines over client documents (embeddings, vector search with pgvector or similar, chunking, evaluation)

Multi-tenant Safety — Ensure AI features respect tenant data isolation, permissions and privacy at all times

Reporting & Exports — Build report exports (PDF, Excel, CSV) and dashboards

App Development — Build and extend features across our Next.js frontend and backend from Figma designs

Bug Fixing & Refactoring — Improve existing Server Actions and components without breaking unrelated features



Tech Stack (Must Have)



Next.js 15 (App Router) — Server Actions used extensively

TypeScript (Strict) — No any types; type safety is a priority

Styling — Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Shadcn UI

Database — PostgreSQL with Kysely query builder (via Neon)

State & Forms — React Context, React Hook Form with Zod validation

AI — Proven experience shipping LLM features to production (not just tutorials or side projects); Vercel AI SDK or similar



Bonus Skills



pgvector / embeddings / RAG evaluation

AI agents and tool calling / MCP

Document processing and generation (PDF/DOCX/XLSX, OCR)

AWS S3 uploads via presigned URLs

Replicache or local-first sync strategies

Experience in compliance, safety, HR or other regulated SaaS



Who You Are



You have shipped real AI features that real users rely on, and can show us

You estimate accurately and deliver what you quote, on time

You pay attention to detail — if the design has 16px padding, you don't make it 20px

You're comfortable working in a large, existing codebase

You communicate clearly in English and flag issues early

You can overlap with Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT) for check-ins



Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid first ticket: building report export options (PDF, Excel, CSV) with an AI-generated executive summary, using mock data. Developers who deliver well move on to ongoing tickets.



How to Apply

To confirm you've read this post, please do the following:



Use the subject line: "Next.js AI Developer Application - [Your Name]"

Our client is Australia’s leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.

High-performing team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations



Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-moving dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

- Clear progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work culture

- Long-term career growth opportunities for high performers

This is not a customer-service, inbound-call, live-chat, patient-management, or social-media role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable spending the majority of their day on the phone, working towards clear daily and weekly call and booking targets.



Key Responsibilities

- Follow up on missed calls, call-backs and unbooked leads in a timely way

- Meet daily and weekly outbound call and appointment-booking targets

- Work closely with the Outbound team lead and share feedback on lead quality and common objections



Required Experience & Skills

- Proven outbound calling, telesales, appointment-setting, or lead-conversion experience is essential

- Strong, clear, and confident spoken English

- Comfortable making outbound calls for extended periods each day

- Strong persuasion, rapport-building, and objection-handling skills

- Experience working towards call-volume, conversion, or booking targets

- Experience using a CRM or dialler (GoHighLevel experience is a bonus)

- Accurate and disciplined with notes and data entry

Preferred Experience

title: Chief of Staff / Project Manager Operations
description:
About The Patch Method™

Weekly meetings, reporting, and accountability rhythms run without the founder needing to organize them.



Product launches, retail initiatives, marketing campaigns, and operational priorities move forward predictably.

Drive product launches from planning through completion. Coordinate suppliers, packaging, inventory, marketing, creative, website updates, and launch deliverables so nothing falls through the cracks.



Coordinate retail and wholesale execution. Track buyer requests, product submissions, packaging requirements, purchase orders, launch calendars, and cross-functional deliverables.



Run the operating rhythm. Lead weekly team meetings, prepare agendas, document decisions, assign next steps, and ensure promised actions are completed.



Build scalable systems and SOPs. Identify repetitive tasks, inefficient workflows, communication gaps, and processes that can be simplified or automated.



Manage deadlines and risks proactively. Identify potential delays early, propose solutions, and escalate decisions to the founder before issues become emergencies.



Create visibility for the CEO. Provide clear weekly executive updates covering project progress, team performance, priorities, blockers, and decisions needed.

Advanced proficiency with project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or equivalent.



Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to lead meetings and communicate directly with the CEO.

title: Lead Generator / Appointment Setter, UK Rentals ($275-$400 base + $200-$250 per let, uncapped)
description:
About the job



About The Business

I’m a self-employed UK estate agent with 700+ rental rooms and apartments. Supply isn’t my problem. Finding serious tenants and getting them through the door is. You’d work directly with me, with no layers of management and a quick path from idea to result.



About The Role

I’m looking for an experienced lead generator to own the tenant pipeline, from first contact to signed let. You’ll find people in places other agents don’t look, qualify them properly, and get them to viewings that turn into tenancies. I’ll provide the properties, pricing and rules. You bring the skill, the channels and the ideas.



This role suits someone who works independently and takes pride in results, not just activity.



What You’ll Do



Find tenants through standard and creative channels: social platforms, community groups and chat apps

Reach international renters, especially students and professionals relocating to the UK

Reply quickly to enquiries and qualify them (budget, move-in date, tenancy length, work or study status, number of occupants)

Book viewings, send reminders, and follow up with quiet leads and no-shows

Track leads, viewings and outcomes in a Google Sheet

Send a short weekly report with numbers, what’s working, and what you’d change



You Might Be a Good Fit If You



Have proven experience in lead generation, appointment setting, recruitment or sales, ideally in property or student housing

Know how to find people in communities and chat apps without spamming 
 groups, Reddit, WhatsApp,
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn)

Write clear, friendly, professional English and reply fast

Can be reachable about 4 hours a day between 9 AM and 6 PM UK time (4/5 PM-1/2 AM Philippine time)

Think in terms of results (lets), not just activity (messages sent)

Enjoy testing what works and dropping what doesn’t



Bonus Points



Fluent Mandarin, Cantonese, Korean or Japanese, and experience reaching audiences in those languages

Experience marketing to international students or relocating professionals

Familiarity with UK rental or student housing



What I Offer (USD)



Base pay of $275-$400 per month for 15-20 hours per week, depending on experience

$200 per room let and $250 per apartment let, uncapped

$150 bonus each month with 3 or more lets

Example: 2 rooms + 1 apartment + the bonus = $800 on top of your base

Payment via Wise or PayPal, with commission paid within 7 days of the tenancy starting

Paid 4-week trial with a target of 2 lets, then ongoing if it’s working

A steady supply of properties and a direct line to the decision maker



Ground Rules

No spam or mass messaging. Follow platform rules and UK data protection law. Never ask prospects for money or holding fees. Every applicant is treated equally, regardless of nationality or background. You qualify and book, and I make all decisions on eligibility and tenancy.



How to Apply (applications missing any of these won’t be read)



Subject line: UK TENANT – [Your Name]

Apply using exactly 8 AP

In under 250 words, tell me:

Your best lead generation or appointment setting result, with numbers

A link or example of your work

The specific communities you’d use to find a serious tenant for a £750/month room in Manchester

Your Philippine-time availability, and whether you’re working another job

Two references or past employer reviews



Shortlisted applicants will have a direct video call with me. I’ll ask about your past results and how you’d approach this role. AI tools are fine for your application, but tell me where you’ve used them.

- Monitor ASIC annual review dates and coordinate annual review requirements.

- Prepare draft ASIC Forms 484 and 362 based on signed client instructions.

- Maintain company registers, officeholder details and corporate records.

- Monitor ATO lodgement deadlines and compliance requirements.

- Request ethical clearance letters from previous accountants and follow up as required.

- Assist with ATO client-agent linking.

- Set up and maintain client records in Xero, Xero Practice Manager and FYI Docs.

- Track outstanding client information and follow up with clients.

- Monitor documents requiring signatures and ensure completed documents are properly filed.

- Coordinate follow-ups with clients and external legal providers.

- Check automated documents and outputs for accuracy, including client details, ACN/ABN, dates and amounts.

- Ensure tasks and compliance deadlines are followed through without constant supervision.



4. Client Communication & General Administration



- Draft routine client
s, information requests and signing reminders.

- Manage reminders for ASIC reviews, ATO lodgements, payments and onboarding requirements.

- Assist with the Director's calendar, appointments and bookings.

- Manage proposals, billing and payment follow-ups through Ignition and Xero.

- Follow up overdue accounts and maintain accurate client records.

- Handle confidential client information responsibly.



Requirements & Qualifications



- Minimum 2 years of experience working in an Australian accounting or public practice firm.

- Practical experience supporting BAS and IAS preparation, processing and lodgement workflows.

- Good understanding of Australian accounting procedures and compliance requirements.

- Experience using Xero and Xero Practice Manager (XPM) is essential.

- Knowledge of ASIC company obligations and ATO Online Services for Agents.

- Experience with client onboarding, ATO client-agent linking and accounting practice workflows.

- Strong administrative, organisational and time-management skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication.

- High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative and proactively follow up outstanding tasks.



Preferred Experience & Tools



Experience with any of the following systems will be an advantage:



- Xero

- Xero Practice Manager (XPM)

- FYI Docs

- Ignition

- Annature or other e-signing platforms

- Microsoft 365

- ASIC Agent Portal

- AI-assisted tools and workflow automation



Important



We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience in an Australian accounting practice.



General bookkeeping experience alone will not be sufficient. Applicants should be familiar with Australian accounting workflows, BAS/IAS processes, ATO requirements and practice management systems.



How to Apply



If you meet the requirements, please send your application via
 with the following:

TrustClub is building the trust base layer for the Philippines — a network where every member is personally vouched for by people who stake their own money and reputation on them. On top of that foundation we run lending, and now jobs. Our lending arm has already proven the model, with default rates far below industry norms. title: HIRING: Exceptional Online Kindergarten Teacher | U.S. Homeschool Curriculum
description:
Position: Private Online Kindergarten Teacher

Work Arrangement: Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term

Starting Rate: $5 USD/hour (paid trial and performance-based increases)

Schedule: Monday–Thursday, U.S. Eastern Time (exact hours to be agreed upon)

Student: One 6-year-old Kindergarten student

Curriculum: Osceola Virtual School (OVS) / Florida Virtual School (FLVS Flex)



About the Position



We are a U.S.-based homeschooling family seeking an outstanding, experienced, patient, and engaging Kindergarten teacher to provide personalized online instruction for our child.



Our child is already enrolled in a structured American homeschool curriculum. We are not looking for a general virtual assistant, babysitter, or conversational English tutor. We need a skilled educator who can explain lessons effectively, develop foundational academic skills, and help our child achieve excellent academic results.



This is a long-term opportunity for a dedicated teacher who genuinely enjoys working with young children.



Key Responsibilities



Teach daily lessons using our existing OVS/FLVS curriculum and pacing guides.



Deliver excellent instruction in phonics, reading, writing, mathematics, science, and social studies.



Develop strong letter recognition, phonemic awareness, phonics, reading fluency, comprehension, handwriting, number sense, and mathematical reasoning.



Explain concepts using interactive activities, storytelling, visual aids, manipulatives, games, and age-appropriate teaching techniques.



Guide the student through assigned lessons and support timely completion of coursework.



Conduct regular practice quizzes, oral assessments, and mastery checks.



Identify learning gaps immediately and provide targeted instruction.



Prepare the student to independently complete required assessments and discussions with assigned OVS teachers.



Review submitted assignment feedback and help the student improve.



Maintain an organized weekly lesson plan and assignment tracker.



Provide parents with brief daily progress reports and a weekly academic summary.



Build confidence, curiosity, independence, positive learning habits, and a love of learning.



Required Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in Elementary Education, Early Childhood Education, or a closely related teaching field.



Preferably a Philippine Licensed Professional Teacher (LPT).



At least 2 years of relevant Kindergarten or early elementary teaching experience.



Excellent spoken and written English with clear pronunciation.



Strong knowledge of systematic phonics, early literacy, and foundational mathematics.



Proven ability to engage young children in live online instruction.



Patient, energetic, encouraging, creative, and highly organized.



Comfortable adapting instruction to a child's learning pace.



Reliable internet, functional webcam, headset, quiet teaching environment, and backup connectivity.



Willingness to provide verifiable professional references and complete appropriate screening.



Preferred: Experience teaching U.S. elementary students, familiarity with American academic standards, and experience supporting online or homeschool curricula.



Performance Expectations



We expect the teacher to:



Prepare for every session and deliver engaging, structured lessons.



Maintain consistent progress against the official weekly curriculum schedule.



Help the student achieve genuine mastery before moving on.



Support timely completion of assigned coursework.



Encourage excellent academic performance without supplying answers to graded work.



Communicate learning difficulties and assignment concerns proactively.



Provide accurate, concise daily updates.



Our goal is A-level academic performance through genuine understanding, not memorization or answer-giving.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume and teaching qualifications.



Your teaching license status, if applicable.



Your Kindergarten teaching experience.



Your experience with phonics and early reading instruction.



Your experience teaching American students, if any.



Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.



Confirmation that you accept the starting rate of $5 USD/hour.



A 2–3 minute video demonstrating how you would teach a 6-year-old a basic phonics or mathematics concept.



Two professional references, available upon request.



Application Screening Question: A 6-year-old can identify letters but struggles to blend sounds into words. Explain your step-by-step teaching approach.



Please begin your application with the words "KINDERGARTEN EXCELLENCE" so we know you have read the full job description.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid live teaching demonstration and interview.



We value exceptional teaching ability, patience, integrity, reliability, and measurable student progress.
