title: Operations Manager: Short-Term Rentals (US Graveyard Shift)
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER: SHORT-TERM RENTALS (US GRAVEYARD SHIFT)



Please read this whole post before applying. The instructions are at the bottom, and how you follow them is the first thing we look at.



ABOUT US



We run short-term rental and vacation rental hosting for owners across the US, fully hands-off. We set a home up, open it to guests on Airbnb and Vrbo, and then somebody runs every stay, every turnover, every vendor call and every 3:00 AM alarm. That second part is this seat.



Nine homes are earning today, eleven are live across four US markets, fourteen hosting agreements are signed, and every owner came from a referral. Most days here are a dispatch board, a vendor who has not called back, a shift log, a hiring pipeline and one decision that has to be made now. Operations, vendor management, scheduling, escalation, owner communication and hospitality customer service, on US hours.



WHAT THIS ROLE REALLY IS



Five contractors cover guest operations every hour of the week, with zero overlap, and none of them has a manager. Every problem that falls between two shifts lands on one phone. Real cases from this seat (the dollar amounts are changed, the counts are not):



- Thirty-two not-started cleaning alerts fired in twenty-six days across four cleaners. Nothing counted them, so a chronic no-show survived for months.

- A damage claim asked for $584.10 and collected $77.20, because the turnover photos that proved it never left a text thread.

- An owner asked about her own statement and waited five days. Nobody owned the reply.



THE PART TO READ TWICE. On day one, nobody reports to you. There is no ops team to take over. The first six months is hiring, writing, wiring and proving. The managing comes after you have built something to manage. If you want to walk into a working department and run it, this is the wrong post, and we would rather say so now than in month three.



The person who is great at this cannot let a repeated failure stay uncounted, and when a vendor misses twice, they have the conversation on the second miss, not the sixth.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Turnovers: every checkout dispatched with a named cleaner before turn day, same-day flips sized in advance, and a per-cleaner scorecard.

- The guest operations bench: shift handoffs, response standards, recovery playbooks, and what is allowed to reach our founder. Over-escalating is a miss too.

- The vendor network, market by market: a W-9 before the first dollar, and a signed services agreement before the first paid clean.

- New home launches, end to end.

- Hiring for operations roles.

- The weekly scoreboard and the escalation, issue and comp logs, none of which exists today.

- The owners' day-to-day contact, from conversion. During the paid trial and the evaluation weeks you have no owner contact and no owner data. Once you convert to the Ongoing Term, owners write to you and you reply the same day for anything before 1:00 PM Pacific, by 10:00 AM Pacific next working morning otherwise. Questions about money, fees, the agreement or what a home will earn go to our founder, warmly, with a time on it.



WHAT YOU CAN DO, AND WHAT YOU WILL NOT



FROM CONVERSION, YOU HOLD SPEND AUTHORITY. You dispatch third-party vendors and authorize operational spend under $500 per event, billed at cost, with no approval from us, logged the same day. Our own construction team's work sits outside your cap, except in a named emergency. You also run guest money, guest side only, inside the limits each owner has approved. $500 and above is the owner's approval, carried by our founder. Outside an emergency, a new vendor at a home also needs that owner's yes in writing first. Never split a $900 repair into two $450 events. That is a breach on its own.



OWNER MONEY. THIS WALL NEVER MOVES, AND IT IS NOT ABOUT YOU. No payouts, no trust account, no bank portal, no payment links. You never touch our accounting system and never mark an invoice paid. You never add, edit or verify anyone's bank or payee details: a request to change where a payment goes is forwarded to us, and you change nothing. Urgency at 2:00 AM is the exact pretext this wall exists to defeat. Owner bank details, tax forms and ID numbers never pass through you, and you never sign anything.



Vendor spend at an owner's home is billable back to that owner, so it is owner money and it lands on a ledger. What makes your cap safe is that you never move it. You authorize the visit and write the row. Somebody else posts the invoice and runs the payout.



Why: money held for an owner requires the person who authorizes a spend and the person who moves it to be two different people. Not because anybody suspects the first one. It is segregation of duties. It applies to the seat, not to you, and it means that when money goes somewhere it should not, it is structurally impossible for it to have been you.



THE OTHER WALLS. No revenue number, fee or term ever reaches an owner from you. You never disclose what we pay a vendor or what another owner pays. No cold calls or cold texts to an owner or a prospect, ever. You never clear a guest back into a home after an alarm; only a qualified person on site does that. You never forward a guest's messages or photos to an owner. You never name anyone on a city's 24/7 local contact filing or conclude a home is permitted; relay what the office said, naming it and the date.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Two or more years leading an operations team. Hiring experience is a plus.

- You have held a vendor to a standard, in writing, with a consequence attached.

- You have written a process somebody else then ran without you.

- You tell somebody senior that a number is wrong, early, in writing.

- Honest. You never report a status you did not verify and never invent a number, a price or a vendor's answer. "I do not know yet, here is how I am finding out" is always right. This is a hard gate at every stage.

- Clear, professional written English, spreadsheet comfort, and stable power and internet with a real backup.



WHAT WE DO NOT CARE ABOUT: your degree, your certifications, or the length of your resume.



HOURS AND TIMEZONE



8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific, Monday to Friday, with one hour out of the middle for a break. A nine-hour span. No weekends.



In Manila that is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM from March to early November (US daylight time), and midnight to 9:00 AM from early November to March. It is a full graveyard shift. The US changes clocks and the Philippines does not, so your Manila hours move twice a year. The window is fixed, it ends at 5:00 PM Pacific, and the overnight phone stays ours.



If 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM Manila from March to early November, and midnight to 9:00 AM Manila from early November to March, does not fit your life, that is a completely reasonable answer. If you are outside the Philippines, tell us on the form what 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific is where you are.



COMPENSATION



- $2,000 per month, flat, not a range, plus up to $600 per calendar quarter on three named targets.

- Each target pays $200. Partial credit is real: two of three pays $400.

- Independent contractor, paid monthly in USD. A paid trial, then an Initial Evaluation Term, then the Ongoing Term.



THE FIRST QUARTER'S THREE TARGETS. Every target is something you can check yourself, and one whose report is not running when the quarter opens does not count against you.



1. Escalation containment. Fewer than four operational issues a month reach our founder that the team or a written standard should have caught, measured off the escalation log you build in month one. Owner questions our written rules send to our founder do not count against you. Routing one late, or not routing it at all, does, and so does sending him one you could have closed yourself.

2. Turn reliability. 98% or more of turnovers verified guest-ready before check-in, and zero guest-facing cleanliness complaints that trace back to a late or missed turn. The data is already in our dispatch tool. The monthly report is the second thing you build.

3. Owner replies. At least 95% of the
s owners send you in the quarter get a reply from your mailbox on time: the same day for anything that lands before 1:00 PM Pacific on a working day, and by 10:00 AM Pacific on your next working morning for anything later. Days of approved time off do not count. Owner mail reaches you only from conversion, so this target counts only from then.



THE PROCESS



1. The application form, about fifty minutes. Several questions ask for the actual words you would send, and those are what we read hardest. Give us the month and the company for anything you managed, because references confirm it.

2. Only if your form passes: a short video and voice task within 48 hours, then a written scenario exercise within 72 hours.

3. A short work-style questionnaire. A tiebreaker, not a gate.

4. An interview with our founder, with live role-plays, for the strongest three to five who clear every gate.

5. Two reference checks, one of them somebody who reported to you or a vendor you held to a standard, not a peer. Then a paid trial.



Every deadline is measured from the
 that reaches you, that
 states your exact deadline, and we do not grant extensions. We answer you at every stage, including when the answer is no.



Please do not use AI to write any of your answers. This process asks you several times for the actual words you would send: to a vendor at eleven at night, to a contractor quietly missing her handoffs, and to us when the thing that went wrong was your call. A model has to invent a person to write those, and it invents the same one every time. Grammar errors cost you nothing here. An answer with no person in it costs you everything.



HOW TO APPLY



Only through the form below. Do not message us here. The last question checks that you read this post, including the hours.

title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description:
About the Role 



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked—this role may be for you. 



Rohring Results is a US-based marketing agency providing SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development for clients across multiple industries. 



We are hiring a Strategy Manager to own the strategic direction behind our client work. 



This is not a single-channel marketing role. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan. 



More importantly: 



This is a research job with a strategy title. 



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it. 



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem. 



What You'll Actually Do 



1. Lead Client Strategy 



-You will own the strategy for new clients, including: 

-Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction 

-Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan 

-Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities 

-Determining what should be prioritized and why 

-Translating research into clear strategic recommendations 

-Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives 



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research 



-You will personally conduct or direct research involving: 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Customer personas 

-Competitive analysis 

-Industry and market research 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research for paid campaigns 

-Competitor messaging and offer analysis 

-Market trends and opportunities 



We are looking for someone who actually does the research, not someone who simply delegates it. 



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable. 



3. Build Brand Foundations 



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning. 



You will help establish: 



-Brand positioning 

-Differentiation 

-Target audience 

-Brand voice 

-Key messaging 

-Value propositions 

-Messaging angles 



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables. 



You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why. 



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative 



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client. 



You will: 



-Review content and creative deliverables 

-Identify when something does not align with strategy 

-Give clear and actionable feedback 

-Approve or reject work before client delivery 

-Explain why something needs to change 

-Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy 



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it. 



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy 



You will determine: 



-Target audience 

-Campaign objective 

-Offer 

-Messaging angle 

-Sequence 

-Call to action 



Our copywriter will write the
s. 



You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work. 



6. Analyze Client Performance 



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools. 



But generating a report is only the beginning. 



You will need to determine: 



-What actually happened? 

-Why did it happen? 

-Which numbers matter? 

-Which numbers are misleading? 

-What changed from the previous period? 

-What should we do next? 

-Does the data actually support the story the report is telling? 

-We need someone who can question the report, not just format it. 



AI Is a Major Part of This Role 



Every agency says it uses AI. 



Here's what we actually mean. 



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different. 



Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong. 



You will be expected to: 



-Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries 

-Build effective prompts and research workflows 

-Iterate instead of accepting the first response 

-Cross-check AI-generated information 

-Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations 

-Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know 

-Know when AI should not be used 

-Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate 

-Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources 

-Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true. 



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly. 



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that looked correct but wasn't—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it. 



What You'll Own 



-Overall marketing strategy for new clients 

-Integrated multi-channel strategy 

-Market and industry research 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Brand positioning and differentiation 

-Customer personas 

-Paid advertising audience strategy 

-Content and creative direction 

-Content and creative approval 


 campaign strategy 

-Client performance reporting 

-Strategic recommendations based on performance data 

-Ongoing independent research 

-Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks 

-Dedicated Research Time 



A portion of every week will be protected for research that is not tied to a specific client. 



This is intentional. 



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities. 



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output. 



That's the point. 



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable. 



 

What We're Looking For 



Required 



Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience 



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including: 



-SEO 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Social Media 

-Content Marketing 


 Marketing 

-Brand Strategy 



We are not looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others. 



Strong Research Experience 



You have personally conducted work such as: 



-Market research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Customer research 

-Personas 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research 

-Industry analysis 



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail. 



Genuine Curiosity 

One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity. 

We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it. 

It does not have to be marketing. 

Strong AI Research Skills 

You understand AI as a research and reasoning instrument, not simply a faster way to write. 



You should be comfortable: 

-Prompting 

-Iterating 

-Fact-checking 

-Comparing sources 

-Challenging AI outputs 

-Building repeatable AI research workflows 



We may assess this skill live. 



Strong Critical Thinking 



You naturally ask: 



-How do we know this? 

-What is the source? 

-What assumption are we making? 

-What would prove this wrong? 

-Is there another explanation? 

-What information are we missing? 

-Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback 



You will have authority over work produced by other team members. 



You need to be comfortable saying: 



“This isn't right yet.” 



More importantly, you need to explain exactly what needs to change and why. 



-Self-Directed 

-Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline. 

-You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next. 

-Communication 

-Excellent written English 

-Strong analytical communication 

-Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues 

-Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly 

-Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions 



 



Nice to Have 



Experience with: 

-Digital marketing agencies 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Paid audience and targeting strategy 

-Google Search Console 

-GA4 

-SEO platforms and analytics 

-Marketing dashboards and reporting 

-Competitive intelligence 

-Brand strategy 

-Marketing automation 

-AI research workflows 

-Creating documented processes that another person can follow 



 

What This Job Is NOT 



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for: 



A content writing position 



An SEO specialist position 



A paid ads specialist position 



A social media manager position 



A role where someone else provides the strategy 



A position where you simply execute instructions 



A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster 



Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute. 



You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working. 



 

About the Working Environment 



This is a senior individual contributor position. 



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority. 



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval. 



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered. 



Our delivery team primarily works on Philippine hours, including daily stand-ups. 



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process. 



 



How to Apply 



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following: 



1. A Research Question You Answered Well 



Tell us: 



What were you trying to find out? 



How did you conduct the research? 



What sources did you use? 



How did you evaluate the information? 



How did you know your conclusion was reliable? 



What decision did the research ultimately influence? 



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer 



Tell us about a situation where: 



An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable 



You discovered that it was wrong or misleading 



Explain how you identified the problem 



Explain how you verified the correct information 



Explain what you changed in your process afterward 



We read these answers before the rest of the application. 



Send to 



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.

title: Part-time Office Support VA (Xero, Data Entry, Records) - Australian Drilling Company
description:
PART-TIME OFFICE SUPPORT VA FOR AN AUSTRALIAN DRILLING COMPANY



Australind Water Boring & Civil (AWBC) drills water bores and installs pumps in the South West of Western Australia. We are a small team: a managing director, an office of three, and drilling crews in the field. Our Office and Systems Lead is based in the Philippines and has run our quoting and invoicing for years; you will report to him and work alongside him every day. Perth is on the same clock as Manila, so there is no night shift.



THE WORK

Twenty hours a week, four hours every weekday morning Perth time, starting Monday 16 November 2026. You will:

- Check supplier bills in Xero against our purchase orders

- Reconcile bank lines in Xero

- Enter bore records and government forms from the drillers' logs, keyed once and exactly

- Lodge dial-before-you-dig requests and check licence status for every job a week before it drills

- Raise purchase orders

- Type the two-week works programme into our job system (AroFlo)

- Run our automations from written instructions and report the same day when one fails

- Keep every bore's file complete

We measure three things: bills checked the day they arrive, records keyed with zero errors, and status checks done a week before each drill date.

- Own laptop, stable internet with a backup, a quiet place to work, and a fixed daily schedule

- Available to start on 16 November or within two weeks of an offer



NOT THIS ROLE

No sales, no customer calls, no social media, no bank payments. The work is accurate, repeatable office processing, and it is measured.



PAY AND TERMS

PHP 26,000 to 32,500 a month for 20 hours a week (PHP 300 to 375 an hour), set by your results in our screening test. Paid fortnightly in pesos as an independent contractor, on the same arrangement as our existing Philippines-based team member. A rate step at day 90 if every process in your scope runs without checking and with zero re-keying. The role can grow to full-time as the scope grows; that is a path, not a promise.



HOW WE HIRE

Application with a short video and a self-scorecard (below); a 30-minute online screening test; a 30-minute interview with the Office and Systems Lead; a final 15 minutes with the managing director for the last two candidates. Everyone who completes the application is told where they stand.



HOW TO APPLY - READ THIS FIRST

Applications that miss a step are not read. The first thing we test is whether you follow written instructions, because that is the job.



1. The first line of your application message must be the number of hours a week in this ad, written as a word.

2. Attach your CV as a PDF, with the months and years of each role.

3. Record a video of no more than five minutes and paste the link (unlisted YouTube, Loom or Google Drive, set so we can open it). Speak plainly in English, no script, no editing, one take is fine. Answer these four, in order:

   a) Tell us about a job where somebody else checked your accuracy. What did they check, how often were you wrong, and what did you change?

   c) Tell us about a time you followed a written procedure that did not work. What did you do in the next ten minutes?

   d) Why does 20 hours a week, every weekday morning, suit you for the next twelve months?

4. Copy the scorecard below into your application and score yourself 0 to 3 on every line: 0 = never done, 1 = done with supervision, 2 = done alone, 3 = done alone and taught someone else. Add one line of evidence for every 2 or 3: where, when, how often. A score with no evidence counts as 0.

5. Answer the three questions under the scorecard.



Applications close Sunday 8 November 2026, 11:59 pm Philippine time.



SCORECARD (copy, then fill in Score and Evidence for each line)

1. Check supplier bills or invoices against purchase orders. Score: __ Evidence: __

2. Bank reconciliation in Xero or another accounting system (name it). Score: __ Evidence: __

4. Lodge forms or applications on a government portal. Score: __ Evidence: __

5. Track the status of many items against deadlines in a spreadsheet and chase the overdue ones. Score: __ Evidence: __

7. Run a process you did not design from a written procedure, and report when it fails. Score: __ Evidence: __

8. Write a short, clear report in English of what you did and found. Score: __ Evidence: __

9. Google Sheets or Excel: lookups, filters, simple formulas. Score: __ Evidence: __

10. Keep a fixed daily schedule working remotely for six months or more. Score: __ Evidence: __

11. Work for an Australian or other overseas employer. Score: __ Evidence: __

12. Receive corrections, keep a record of your own errors, and reduce them. Score: __ Evidence: __



THREE QUESTIONS

- Which parts of Xero have you used, and when did you last use them? If none, which accounting system, and for what?

- When did you last reconcile a bank account, for whom, and how many lines a month?

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Print & Apparel Production (Full-Time, Long-Term)



If you're ambitious, a fast learner, extremely organized, detail-oriented, and great at keeping things moving – and most importantly, someone who takes ownership of projects and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks – you're exactly who I'm looking for.



I currently operate a growing business specializing in custom printing, apparel, and related products. We work with customers on a wide variety of projects, and I'm looking for a great project manager who can help us keep everything organized, running smoothly, and delivered on time.



Organization is by far the most important trait for this position. You don't need to know everything about printing or apparel production on day one, but you do need to be the kind of person who naturally keeps track of details, follows up without being asked, and takes pride in making sure things get done correctly.



When hiring, I intend to provide a full-time, permanent position for you. In addition to my US-based employees, I currently have a small team of Filipino employees who are absolutely wonderful, and I'm eager to grow with more amazing and talented men and women.



Please understand in advance that this application has very specific requirements, resulting in lower competition. Please read it carefully and apply correctly to be considered.



The Job:



I'm looking for a full-time project manager who can take projects from our sales team and manage them through the production process, making sure every order is accurate, organized, and completed on schedule.



Your most important responsibility will be taking jobs from our sales team, creating detailed order packets, and sending those jobs to production. These packets need to contain all the information our production team needs to complete the job correctly, without confusion or unnecessary back-and-forth.



From there, you'll be responsible for tracking each job through production, communicating with the appropriate people, identifying potential delays, and making sure orders are completed and delivered on time.



Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:



Receiving new jobs from the sales team and reviewing all order details for accuracy and completeness.



Creating clear, detailed production order packets with specifications, artwork, quantities, deadlines, and other important information.



Submitting jobs to our production team and making sure they have everything needed to get started.



Tracking multiple orders at different stages of production and keeping their statuses up to date.



Following up proactively with production teams and vendors to make sure deadlines are being met.



Catching missing information, mistakes, or potential delays before they become bigger problems.



Communicating with our sales team to provide updates and resolve questions.



Helping improve our systems and processes as the business continues to grow.



What I'm Looking For:



Above all else, I'm looking for someone who is exceptionally organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.



You should be comfortable managing many moving pieces at once, keeping track of deadlines, and taking responsibility for making sure nothing gets forgotten.



Experience in the printing, custom apparel, screen printing, embroidery, or promotional products industry is a definite plus, but not required.



Some graphic design experience is a HUGE plus. Being comfortable working with artwork, understanding file formats, and making basic adjustments in programs like Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop would be incredibly valuable in this position.



You should also be a strong communicator, comfortable using computers and project management software, and willing to learn new systems quickly.



The Opportunity:



You'll be working full-time during US business hours and will become an important part of our daily operations.



The most important aspect of this job is the ability to learn new skills, think critically, stay organized, and solve problems independently.



I don't want someone who simply waits to be told what to do next. I'm looking for someone who takes ownership, anticipates problems, and genuinely cares about getting things right.



As our business grows, there will be opportunities for you to take on more responsibility, improve our operations, and grow professionally along with the company.



If you're looking for a stable, long-term position where your attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to get things done will be genuinely valued, I'd love for you to apply.



Excellent English speaking skills is REQUIRED.

A learned American / Southern US / British / Australian accent is a PLUS.

A PC/Mac powerful enough to handle timeproof, justcall, and zoom simultaneously is REQUIRED.

A fast and stable internet connection is REQUIRED



To apply for this job;



1. Respond with the subject, "I'm the Amazing PM you're looking for! Just ask [insert the name of one of the companies on the home page of www.royalprints.shop]"



2: In the first line of your message, say "Hello from [insert the city in which our company is headquartered]



3. Next, please write 3 sentences explaining why you would like this position and what makes you a good fit. More or less than that will disqualify the application.



4. After answering 3, please let me know of any specifically relevant experience you have. Please attach a copy of the google logo from 2007.



5. Attach your CV.



If you have a personal website or resume, link those as well.



Make sure to follow the above steps. This is a great job opportunity where you will be able to receive bonuses, and raises. The reason for the extra steps is to filter out the noise so that I can see the applications of those who really want the job. If you are selected for an interview, we'll speak over zoom/google meet call, requiring video.



Please do not write any more information that what I have asked above, that will cause your application to be disqualified. If you got this far, you have a much higher chance of actually getting a full time position than with other job postings. The competition for a job like this will be much lower, because many people who would submit an application randomly will not take the time to submit a complete application - or they may submit a disqualifying application. This is designed to give you a chance to stand out, I'm looking forward to meeting you,



-Casey

title: Key Account Manager
description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER – MINDANAO

Jupiter e-Mobility Corporation

Based in Davao City | Mindanao-wide field coverage



About the Role



Jupiter e-Mobility Corporation is looking for a Key Account Manager to develop new business and manage customer accounts across Mindanao. You will help customers find electric mobility solutions that fit their needs, lead sales discussions, and build lasting business relationships.



You will handle an assigned brand—RFN or TAILG—and work closely with Inside Sales, the Sales Manager, and our operations and support teams.



Key Responsibilities



- Identify potential business accounts and develop sales opportunities across Mindanao.

- Manage existing accounts, encourage repeat purchases, and maintain strong customer relationships.

- Follow up qualified leads from Inside Sales and arrange client visits.

- Understand customer requirements, budget, intended use, and purchasing timeline.

- Conduct presentations, product demonstrations, and sales negotiations.

- Prepare proposals and quotations using approved prices and payment terms.

- Close sales and coordinate customer documents, payment verification, stock allocation, and delivery.

- Work with Finance on payment commitments and collection follow-ups.

- Coordinate technical and after-sales concerns and keep customers informed.

- Maintain accurate account records, sales forecasts, and weekly activity reports.

- Plan field visits and travel schedules to cover assigned territories effectively.

- Meet agreed sales, account development, and collection targets.

- Coordinate cross-brand referrals while maintaining clear account ownership.



**Qualifications**



- Preferably at least two years of experience in sales, business development, or key account management.

- Experience in motorcycles, automotive, electric mobility, or related industries is an advantage.

- Proven ability to prospect, negotiate, and close sales.

- Strong communication, presentation, and customer relationship skills.

- Organized, proactive, and consistent with documentation and follow-ups.

- Comfortable using spreadsheets,
, and sales tracking tools.

- Willing to travel regularly throughout Mindanao.

- A valid driver’s license and ability to drive are preferred.

- A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.



Work Arrangement



Based in Davao City, with regular client visits and travel across Mindanao. This role reports to the Sales Manager.



Apply through Indeed with your updated résumé. Please highlight your sales achievements, industries handled, and areas covered in Mindanao.

title: TikTok Livestream Host – Crypto / Memecoin Entertainment
description:
Location: Philippines (On-site)

Salary: ₱30,000–₱40,000/month + performance bonuses

Employment: Full-time



About the position



We are looking for 3–5 energetic, charismatic, and English-speaking livestream hosts to join our crypto entertainment team.



You will be hosting daily TikTok LIVE broadcasts targeting an American audience, representing a growing cryptocurrency community.



Our studio is equipped with professional streaming equipment, a webcam, and an AI-powered anime avatar system. Your real face will NOT be displayed during livestreams. Instead, an animated character will replicate your movements in real time.



This is an entertainment-focused position. We want people who genuinely enjoy talking, entertaining audiences, and interacting with online communities.



Your responsibilities



• Host live TikTok broadcasts for 8 hours per scheduled shift.

• Speak naturally and confidently in English, preferably with an American-style accent.

• Interact constantly with viewers through the livestream chat.

• Welcome new viewers and encourage them to participate in conversations.

• Explain the memecoin, its community, features and ecosystem accurately.

• Create an energetic and entertaining atmosphere.

• Respond to audience questions and maintain engagement.

• Follow the provided livestream scripts and daily content guidelines.

• Maintain a consistent streaming schedule.



Requirements



• Must be 18 years old or older.

• Excellent spoken English.

• American or neutral American-style accent strongly preferred.

• Energetic, outgoing and charismatic personality.

• Comfortable talking continuously for extended periods.

• Strong communication and improvisation skills.

• Interest in cryptocurrency, memes, internet culture or social media.

• Comfortable using computers and basic streaming software.

• Reliable, punctual and able to work scheduled shifts.



Previous experience in TikTok LIVE, Twitch, YouTube streaming, gaming, sales or content creation is a plus.



Compensation and benefits



• Monthly base salary: ₱30,000–₱40,000 depending on experience.

• Performance-based monthly bonuses of up to ₱10,000.

• Paid training.

• Professional streaming equipment provided.

• Stable, long-term employment opportunity.

• Opportunity to grow within an international digital entertainment company.



Working schedule



• 8-hour scheduled shifts.

• Morning, afternoon, and overnight shifts available.

• Rotating schedules where necessary.

• Weekly rest days and applicable overtime compensation.



How to apply



Please send us:



1. Your full name, age, and location.

2. A short introduction about yourself.

3. Your previous livestreaming or content creation experience, if any.

4. A 1–2 minute English voice/video sample demonstrating your communication skills and personality.

5. Your expected monthly salary.



Important: Your real face will not be shown to the livestream audience. The broadcasts use an AI-generated anime avatar.



We are looking for confident personalities who can entertain an American audience and help build an active online community.

title: E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

Attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions are part of our screening process. Each step is clearly outlined, so please read carefully and complete all requirements.

Incomplete applications or those that fail to follow instructions will not be considered.





E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Communicate progress, challenges, and blockers proactively.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

13th Month Pay: Provided annually

Paid Holidays: Paid Philippine Regular and Special Non-Working Holidays

Paid Time Off (PTO): 5 paid leave days per year

Team Environment: Collaborative and supportive remote team

Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to e-commerce tools and operations



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Initially, the role focuses on learning MORALVE's systems, completing recurring tasks accurately, and maintaining reliable records. With demonstrated consistency, accountability, and judgment, the assistant may progress toward independent ownership of operational processes, advanced marketplace and inventory responsibilities, reporting and reconciliation, workflow improvement, and cross-functional project coordination.

title: Part-Time Medical Biller / Revenue Cycle Specialist — U.S. Professional Claims
description:
We are seeking an experienced, Philippines-based medical biller to manage the complete revenue cycle for professional services provided primarily during nursing-home visits.



Hands-on experience with Medicare, Medicaid and commercial insurance is required. This is not an entry-level role. Nursing-home billing experience is preferred, but not mandatory.



You will own claims from eligibility verification and submission through payment follow-up, including:

- Claim rejections, denials, corrections and appeals.

- Accounts-receivable follow-up and payer communication.

- Payment posting, remittance review and balance reconciliation.

- Clear tracking of outstanding claims, deadlines and next actions.

- Escalation of coding, clinical and financial decisions requiring approval.



You must be comfortable learning and using approved AI tools, checking their accuracy and protecting patient information.



Schedule: Part-time, 10–20 hours per week to start, with agreed U.S. business-hour overlap.

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and scope.



To apply, provide your résumé, billing systems used, hands-on experience with each required payer category, and one example of an unpaid claim you personally followed through to resolution. Include your available hours, expected rate and earliest start date. Do not submit patient records or confidential employer documents.
salary: Negotiable based on experience and scope

title: Social media creator and scheduling
description:
HIRING: Social Media Manager & Content Creator



Remote Position | Ongoing Opportunity | Australia / International



I’m looking for a creative, motivated and organised Social Media Manager & Content Creator to help build and grow my personal brand and upcoming clothing brand, Bowie Essence.



About Me



I’m a 21-year-old carpenter, endurance athlete and aspiring content creator based in Queensland, Australia.



My content revolves around everyday life, ultrarunning, endurance challenges, personal growth, discipline, adventure and raising awareness and funds for pancreatic cancer through Pankind.



I lost my dad to pancreatic cancer, and one of my biggest goals is to use social media and endurance challenges to make a positive difference for families affected by this disease.



I’m also developing my own clothing and lifestyle brand, Bowie Essence.



I’m looking for someone who can understand my vision, help tell my story and turn everyday moments into engaging content that people genuinely connect with.



Your Responsibilities



1. Content Strategy & Planning



* Develop a weekly content strategy and posting schedule.

* Research trending content, sounds, formats and opportunities.

* Generate fresh video ideas and creative concepts.

* Build repeatable content series around my lifestyle and journey.

* Identify opportunities to grow my audience and engagement.



2. Video Editing & Content Creation



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

* Create engaging hooks, captions, subtitles and transitions.

* Select suitable music, sounds and footage.

* Create professional video covers and graphics.

* Turn raw footage into engaging stories.

* Maintain a consistent visual style and brand identity.



3. Social Media Management



* Organise and manage the content calendar.

* Write captions and prepare hashtags.

* Schedule and publish approved content.

* Manage content across my social media accounts.

* Monitor engagement, reach, views and audience growth.

* Provide regular performance reports and recommendations.



4. Brand Development



* Help develop my personal brand and online identity.

* Assist with the growth and development of Bowie Essence.

* Research clothing, lifestyle and fashion content trends.

* Help create a recognisable and consistent online presence.



The Content You’ll Be Working With



* Ultramarathons and extreme endurance challenges.

* Running, training and athletic progression.

* Pancreatic cancer awareness and fundraising.

* My everyday life as a young carpenter.

* Discipline, personal development and motivational content.

* Nature, photography and lifestyle.

* Building my own clothing brand.



Who I’m Looking For



* Someone creative with a strong understanding of social media.

* Experience editing Instagram Reels and TikTok videos.

* Someone who understands storytelling and audience retention.

* Excellent communication and organisation skills.

* Someone who can work independently and bring their own ideas.

* Someone who understands current social media trends.

* Experience growing personal brands or creator accounts is a bonus.

* An interest in fitness, endurance sport, lifestyle or fashion is an advantage.



I’m not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. I want someone proactive who takes ownership, brings ideas to the table and genuinely wants to help build something long-term.



How We’ll Work Together



This is a remote position.



I’ll provide raw footage, everyday content, ideas and updates about my life and upcoming challenges.



You’ll take responsibility for planning, organising, editing and managing the content process from start to finish.



We’ll use Notion and Google Drive to organise content, communicate and track progress.



All content will be submitted for approval before publishing.



What I’m Offering



* Ongoing remote working opportunity.

* Creative freedom to bring your ideas to the table.

* Opportunity to help build two growing brands.

* A chance to be involved in meaningful endurance and fundraising projects.

* Potential for a long-term working relationship as the brands grow.



How to Apply



If you’re interested, please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Examples of social media accounts or content you’ve managed.

3. Examples of videos you’ve edited.

4. Your experience with Instagram and TikTok growth.

5. Your proposed monthly rate and what services are included.

6. Your availability and time zone.



I’m looking for someone who wants to be part of building something meaningful, creative and bigger than just social media.



Let’s build something worth following.

title: Hybrid Virtual Assistant – Customer Service & Operations
description:
Geaux Elite Auto Rentals is seeking a dependable, highly organized, and proactive Hybrid Virtual Assistant to join our growing team.



This is a full-time position from Day 1 and is designed for someone who can become a strong combination of both customer service and administrative operations.



Our current team includes dedicated support in both administrative operations and customer service. This position will serve as the third VA on the team and will help bridge both sides of the operation while strengthening our weekday, evening, and Saturday coverage.



The right person must be comfortable switching between customer-facing responsibilities and behind-the-scenes administrative work based on what the business needs that day.



Compensation



Starting Rate: $3.00 USD per hour



Schedule: Approximately 40 hours per week



Probationary Period: 90 days



90-Day Performance Review: Opportunity to increase to $4.00 USD per hour based on performance



The 90-day review will consider reliability, attendance, communication, attention to detail, customer-service performance, administrative competency, ability to work independently on Saturdays, proper documentation, judgment, initiative, and overall growth within the role.



The $4.00/hour rate is performance-based and is not automatic. Strong performers who successfully develop into the full expectations of the Hybrid VA role will be considered for the increase.



What This Role Is Designed To Do



During weekday shifts, you will often work alongside or overlap with other team members.



Depending on the day, your responsibilities may lean more heavily toward:



Administrative work



Customer service



Lead follow-up



Payment monitoring



Rental operations



Documentation



Scheduling



Reservation support



Once the other VAs have completed their shifts, you may become the primary point of contact for the remainder of the day.



You must be comfortable transitioning from administrative work into customer service — or from customer service into administrative work — depending on what is happening within the business.



This role requires someone who can look at the operation, understand what needs attention, and adjust accordingly.



Customer Service Responsibilities



You may be responsible for:



Responding to current renter messages



Answering prospective renter inquiries



Following up with leads



Helping move qualified prospects toward reservations



Following up on reservation fees



Confirming upcoming pickups and returns



Sending payment reminders



Monitoring promised payments



Following up on overdue payments according to company procedures



Answering routine renter questions



Coordinating routine maintenance communication



Reviewing previous conversations before responding



Documenting customer interactions and important updates



Escalating situations when necessary



Strong communication is extremely important in this role.



You must be able to communicate professionally, clearly, confidently, and naturally with customers through both written messages and phone calls.



Administrative Responsibilities



You will also be trained to assist with important administrative functions, including:



Reviewing upcoming renter payments



Updating invoices



Updating payment records



Preparing and sending rental agreements



Preparing agreements for upcoming rentals



Reviewing renter account information



Updating renter and vehicle notes



Reviewing payment status and balances



Helping maintain accurate internal records



Monitoring upcoming renewals



Assisting with maintenance scheduling and follow-up



Reviewing handoff notes from other team members



Following up on unresolved tasks



Helping ensure information is properly documented for the next shift



You are not expected to know all of these systems immediately.



However, you are expected to learn them, become comfortable with them, and eventually be able to perform essential functions independently when another team member is unavailable.



Saturday Is a Major Part of This Position



Saturday is one of our more important operating days.



The Hybrid VA will be the primary VA working on Saturdays.



You will usually have notes and handoffs prepared by the weekday team, but you must be comfortable working independently.



Saturday responsibilities will primarily focus on customer service and active rental operations.



This may include:



Responding to renter questions



Responding to new leads



Following up with prospective renters



Monitoring payments



Confirming reservations



Monitoring pickups and returns



Reviewing unresolved items from Friday



Using renter history and account notes to understand situations



Documenting anything that needs to be addressed the following week



Escalating serious situations when appropriate



We are specifically looking for someone who can remain productive and make good routine decisions even when another VA is not immediately available.



Schedule



This position will generally be approximately 40 hours per week.



The expected schedule will primarily include:



Tuesday through Friday: Afternoon/evening coverage

Saturday: Daytime coverage



Weekday hours may occasionally fluctuate depending on business needs.



Saturday availability is required.



Because this is a hybrid role, flexibility is important.



Some weekday shifts may be more administrative.



Others may require heavier customer-service coverage.



The ability to adjust without becoming overwhelmed is essential.



What We Expect From You



We are looking for someone who:



Communicates clearly and professionally



Pays close attention to details



Reviews previous messages and account history before asking questions



Can follow established procedures



Can work without constant supervision



Is comfortable handling customers



Is comfortable making routine decisions within established guidelines



Understands when something should be escalated



Can prioritize multiple responsibilities



Documents information accurately



Follows through on tasks



Does not allow customer situations or administrative tasks to sit unresolved



Can adapt when priorities change during a shift



Is comfortable learning multiple parts of the business



Takes accountability for their work



Is dependable and punctual



Has a stable internet connection and reliable backup connection



Has a quiet and professional work environment



We value initiative.



When possible, we do not want team members to simply say:



“There is a problem. What should I do?”



We want team members to gradually develop the ability to say:



“This is the situation. I reviewed the account and our procedures. I believe the next step should be ___. Please confirm.”



Good judgment will be developed through training, but the willingness to think independently is required.



This Position May NOT Be a Good Fit If You:



Need constant supervision



Frequently miss details



Do not review previous messages before asking questions



Have difficulty communicating with customers



Are uncomfortable speaking on the phone



Avoid making routine decisions



Struggle with changing priorities



Prefer doing only administrative work



Prefer doing only customer-service work



Frequently leave tasks unfinished



Are unavailable on Saturdays



Are looking for a short-term position



Training & Growth



This position will receive structured training in both:



Customer Operations

and

Administrative Operations



You will work closely with our existing team and learn how the different parts of the business connect.



As you become more experienced, you will be expected to handle more situations independently.



We are building for long-term growth and want team members who are interested in growing with the company.



As the business continues to expand, opportunities may become available for:



Increased responsibility



Additional training



Expanded operational duties



Leadership development



Compensation growth based on performance



How To Apply



Read this section carefully. Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



Send your application by
 to:







Use the exact subject line:



Hybrid VA Application - Customer Service & Operations



At the very top of your
, include the sentence:



“I read the full job post.”



Your application should include all of the following:



Your full name



Your updated resume



A short introduction explaining why you are interested in this position



Your previous experience with virtual assistance, customer service, administrative work, sales, or similar roles



Your availability Tuesday through Saturday in U.S. Central Time



Your expected hourly rate



A short video introduction of no more than 3 minutes



In the video, please introduce yourself and explain:



Your previous experience



Three reasons you believe you would be a strong fit for this position



Why you are comfortable working independently on Saturdays



Answer the following scenario in your
:



It is Saturday afternoon. A renter's payment was due Friday. The renter messages you and says they cannot pay until Monday. No other VA is currently working. Explain the steps you would take before d
 whether the situation needs to be escalated.



Answer this second question:



You begin your weekday shift with several administrative tasks that need to be completed. Thirty minutes later, multiple new renter inquiries begin coming in at the same time. Explain how you would determine what to prioritize and how you would make sure nothing gets missed.



Important



We are looking for someone who takes instructions seriously.



Please make sure your application includes:



The correct
 subject



The required sentence at the top of the



Your resume



Your introduction



Your availability



Your expected hourly rate



Your video

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python/Django)
description:
Company: US-Based SaaS Startup

Position: Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | Long-Term

Bonus: 13th-Month Bonus

Schedule: Flexible – Work Normal Philippine Daytime Hours (No Overnight US Shift)



**About the Opportunity**



We're a US-based software company building a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform that connects accounting, customer relationships, operations, workflows, and other essential business functions into one integrated system. After 18 months of development, we're looking for our first external software engineer to help complete our MVP, improve existing functionality, and prepare the product for launch. You'll work directly with a technical founder who leads the overall product vision and architecture, while taking ownership of meaningful development work. We're looking for someone who doesn't just write code to make something work, but thinks critically about how to build scalable, flexible, and maintainable systems that can evolve as the product grows.



**What You'll Do**



• Full-Stack Development: Build and improve features across our Django backend, PostgreSQL database, and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend.

• Scalable System Design: Develop reusable, configurable, and extensible solutions rather than relying on hardcoded logic or short-term workarounds.

• Feature Ownership: Independently take features from requirements through implementation, testing, and completion.

• Architecture & Problem-Solving: Understand how different modules interact, anticipate edge cases, and recommend thoughtful technical solutions.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Assist with AWS deployments, environment configuration, CI/CD processes, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

• Quality & Performance: Debug complex issues, optimize queries and application performance, write automated tests, and improve security and reliability.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with the founder to evaluate approaches, identify improvements, and help prepare the platform for production.



**Our Tech Stack**



• Backend: Python, Django

• Database: PostgreSQL

• Frontend: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JavaScript

• Testing: pytest

• Background Tasks: Celery, Redis

• Infrastructure & DevOps: AWS, Git, CI/CD, deployment and monitoring tools

• Other: REST APIs, third-party integrations



**What We're Looking For**



• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on Python/Django expertise.

• Strong knowledge of Django architecture, PostgreSQL, relational database design, and query optimization.

• Comfortable building interactive interfaces using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

• Experience designing scalable, dynamic, and maintainable systems with reusable components and configurable business logic.

• Ability to understand and extend existing complex codebases without introducing unnecessary complexity or technical debt.

• Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals, cloud deployments, and production application troubleshooting.

• Strong debugging, problem-solving, testing, and performance optimization skills.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and make sound technical decisions with minimal supervision.

• Proactive communication, attention to detail, and good written and spoken English.



**Nice to Have**



• Experience building ERP, CRM, SaaS, or other business management platforms.

• Experience with AG Grid, particularly advanced data tables, filtering, editing, and dynamic data-driven interfaces.

• Experience with Celery, Redis, background processing, and API integrations.

• Stronger AWS, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or application monitoring experience.

• Experience helping bring early-stage software products into production.



**Why Join Us**



• Meaningful Ownership: Take responsibility for important features and contribute to how the product is built.

• Work With a Technical Founder: Collaborate directly with someone who understands software development and values thoughtful engineering.

• Interesting Technical Challenges: Build interconnected systems with complex business workflows, dynamic interfaces, and evolving requirements.

• Flexible Working Hours: Work during normal Philippine daytime hours. No overnight US shift required.

• Long-Term Growth: Join early and have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities as the product and engineering team expand.



**How to Apply**



1. Your resume/CV and a brief overview of your Python/Django experience.

2. Your GitHub, portfolio, or examples of relevant projects, if available.

3. A brief example of a complex feature or system you independently designed or developed. How did you make it scalable, flexible, or maintainable rather than relying on hardcoded solutions?

4. Your expected monthly salary (USD) and earliest availability.



We're looking for a thoughtful, dependable engineer who takes pride in building quality software, solves problems independently, and thinks beyond simply completing assigned tasks. If you enjoy building well-designed systems and want to make a meaningful impact on a growing software product, we'd love to hear from you.

THE ROLE IN THREE SENTENCES

You will own the accuracy and timeliness of every client bookkeeping file that moves through our Virtual CFO service line. You will recruit, train and lead the bookkeepers who work under you. And you will design the systems and quality checks that let this division scale without things breaking.



WHY THIS MATTERS

Our accounting clients are Australian business owners who need more than a set of books. They need a bookkeeping function they can trust completely, so our advisers can focus on the advice that moves their business forward. Right now that function needs a leader. Get this right and you are the reason our clients get accurate numbers on time, every time.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Bookkeeping Delivery and Compliance

● Run reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, payroll and BAS/IAS preparation across the client portfolio.

● Every file in your portfolio is reconciled and closed within the agreed monthly turnaround.

● The first bookkeepers under you are onboarded, trained and producing work you would sign off yourself.

● You have a working set of SOPs and a clear view of where the bottlenecks are, with a plan to fix them.



WHO YOU ARE

title: Sales Closer — Residential Cleaning (Remote, Full-Time, USD Pay)
description:
Sales Closer — Residential Cleaning

(Remote, Full-Time, USD Pay)



At 5 Star Home Cleaning, we believe great salespeople are great listeners first. We’re an established U.S. residential cleaning company operating in Arizona, Montana, and California, and we’re hiring one full-time Sales Closer.

Your job isn’t to sell people a cleaning they don’t need — it’s to help them get the one they do. Every lead you speak with has already requested a quote, so you’re working warm inbound only.



What a great call looks like



Connect — build genuine rapport and make the homeowner feel heard.

Listen & understand — ask thoughtful questions to learn their home, their challenges, and what matters most to them.

Recommend — match their needs to the right service. Never oversell.

Guide & close — explain the value, work through concerns, confidently ask for the business, collect payment, and get the cleaning scheduled.

Follow through — keep GoHighLevel accurate and make sure the client feels taken care of.

Our philosophy: Listen first. Serve second. The sale follows.



Compensation

Base: Starts at $5/hour, increasing to $7/hour as you advance.

Commission: Starts at 2% of cash collected, increasing to 5% with performance.

Bonus: Each recurring client you sign up is rewarded $10-$30

Uncapped earning potential — the more business you close, the more you earn.



Growth path

Three tiers: Junior, Intermediate, Senior. Hit your cash-collected target five times to advance, increasing both your hourly pay and commission. Growth is based on results, not seniority or office politics.



You’ll thrive here if you:

Listen more than you talk, and make people feel genuinely heard

Have phone sales experience converting conversations into paying customers

Are confident asking for the business

Communicate in warm, conversational English and build trust fast

Are coachable, organized, dependable, and take ownership of results



This isn’t the right fit if you:

Rely on pressure or manipulation to close

Get defensive about feedback

Prefer a fixed salary over performance-based pay



What you’ll get

100% warm inbound leads, uncapped commission, a clear path from Junior to Senior, weekly sales coaching from leaders who’ve scaled a multi-location company, and a proven process with scripts, training, and support.



Requirements

Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and availability during U.S. business hours (Mountain/Pacific time).

We would love to invite you to schedule a zoom interview, please fill out this application and then it will allow you to choose a time for an interview!

title: Google Business Profile Specialist (Local SEO), SEO Agency (Part-Time, Remote)

title: Australian Accountant – Bookkeeping, BAS and Tax
description:
Accountant (Bookkeeping & BAS)

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Australian Accounting Practice



About the Role

Cruz & Co, a Sydney-based accounting and tax practice, is seeking an experienced Accountant (Bookkeeping & BAS) to join its team remotely from the Philippines.

This role combines year-end accounting and tax compliance with ongoing bookkeeping and Business Activity Statement (BAS) preparation for a portfolio of approximately 30 business clients.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience preparing financial statements, tax returns, and BAS, along with strong bookkeeping skills and knowledge of Australian tax and compliance requirements.



Key Responsibilities



Year-End Accounting & Tax Compliance

Prepare financial statements, tax workpapers, and tax returns for companies, trusts, and partnerships.

Prepare bank reconciliations, fixed asset schedules, depreciation journals, and loan workpapers.

Reconcile GST, BAS, PAYG, and general ledger accounts.

Prepare tax calculations, tax journals, and supporting documentation.

Address reviewer feedback and client queries, ensuring accurate and timely completion of work.



Bookkeeping

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping for approximately 30 clients using Xero and QuickBooks Online.

Review and code bank transactions and perform monthly or quarterly reconciliations.

Process accounts payable and receivable where required.

Manage payroll, Single Touch Payroll (STP), and superannuation for applicable clients.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records.



BAS & Activity Statements

Prepare quarterly and monthly Business Activity Statements (BAS) and Instalment Activity Statements (IAS).

Reconcile GST and PAYG withholding against accounting records and payroll reports.

Coordinate client approvals and ensure timely lodgment through the tax agent portal.

Monitor lodgment deadlines and follow up on outstanding client information.

Prepare annual GST and fuel tax credit reconciliations where applicable.



Client Communication & Workflow Management

Request missing information and follow up with clients promptly.

Maintain accurate job statuses and time records in the practice management system.

Identify and escalate potential compliance issues to the reviewing accountant.

Manage deadlines while maintaining accurate, well-documented workpapers.



Requirements

At least 2 years of accounting experience preparing financial statements and tax returns for companies, trusts, and partnerships.

Hands-on experience with bookkeeping and BAS preparation using Xero.

Knowledge of Australian GST, PAYG withholding and instalments, STP, superannuation guarantee, and Division 7A.

Experience preparing tax workpapers and reconciling ATO accounts.

Strong written English and the ability to prepare clear, well-organized workpapers.

Excellent attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills.

Ability to manage multiple clients and meet recurring compliance deadlines.

Australian public practice experience is preferred. Candidates with a CPA qualification or currently studying towards one may also be considered without Australian accounting experience.



Preferred Qualifications & Experience

Degree in Accounting or a related field.

CA or CPA qualification, or progress towards one.

Experience with Reportance and QuickBooks Online.

Registered BAS Agent experience or familiarity with Australian BAS lodgment requirements.



Working Arrangements

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Remote, based in the Philippines

Working Hours: Sydney business hours, approximately 6:00 AM–2:00 PM Philippine time during Australian daylight saving and 7:00 AM–3:00 PM otherwise.

Systems: Xero, QuickBooks Online, Reportance, Google Workspace, and practice management software.

Workload: Approximately 30 bookkeeping clients, alongside year-end compliance and tax preparation.



The role requires strict adherence to client confidentiality and data security policies. All client information must remain within the firm's approved systems, with no local copies stored on personal devices.



Candidates should be comfortable managing workload peaks around BAS due dates and year-end tax lodgment deadlines.



How to Apply

If you have a strong accounting background, hands-on Xero experience, and knowledge of Australian accounting and tax compliance, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit your CV highlighting your relevant accounting experience, software proficiency, and qualifications.
