title: Cold call and sales Coach 1 on 1
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

description:

real estate solutions.

strategies.

Agent (ISA) who can think three steps ahead, communicate confidently with prospective clients,

and turn conversations into meaningful business opportunities.



If you are passionate about sales, enjoy building relationships, and have the drive to generate

leads and secure appointments, we want to hear from you!



Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to support our growing real estate

operations.



This position focuses on outbound prospecting, lead generation, lead qualification,

relationship building, appointment setting, and consistent follow-up with prospective buyers,

sellers, investors, and property owners.



The successful candidate will proactively identify opportunities, engage prospects through phone

calls, text messages,
s, and CRM campaigns, and convert qualified leads into appointments

for our licensed real estate professionals.



This is not simply a cold-calling position. We want someone who understands how to develop

relationships, identify opportunities, overcome objections, and consistently move leads through

the sales pipeline.



The ideal candidate is self-motivated, confident, organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable working

in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation & Prospecting

• Conduct outbound calls to prospective buyers, sellers, investors, and property owners.

• Contact new, existing, and previously inactive leads.

s, and text messages.

opportunities.

:

title: Supply Chain Director
description:
We The Wild is a fast-growing plant care brand selling direct to consumers in Australia and the US, and through Target and Amazon. Our products are assembled from components (bottles, caps, plugs, liquids and cartons) made by suppliers in China and assembled by contract manufacturers. We work with 3PLs in Australia and the US.



The role

We’re looking for a senior supply chain leader to build and own our supply chain from end to end. You’ll design the systems, processes and planning models that run our operations, and then run them day to day.



We’re a lean team, so this role suits someone who is as comfortable building a 12-month planning model as raising a PO or chasing a forwarder. You’ll move between hands-on work and management as the business needs, with full ownership and accountability for results.



What you’ll build and own



Team: you’ll be supported by one direct report, so you’ll split your time between leading and doing.

Planning system: build and maintain the model that turns our sales forecast into assembly plans, component requirements (BOM) and purchase orders. Set the rules for safety stock, reorder points and order quantities.

Processes: create clear, repeatable processes for purchasing, receiving, stock reconciliation and supplier management, documented so they scale as we grow.

Purchasing: raise and manage POs with suppliers in China and contract manufacturers, working within lead times, MOQs, order multiples and price breaks.

Freight and logistics: d
 between sea, air and LCL, manage forwarders and 3PLs, and track landed cost per PO.

Finance: own the 12-month inventory and freight spend plan, actuals vs plan, and the cash forecast for stock.

Systems: own our inventory system (Cin7) and the accuracy of its data.

S&OP: run a monthly planning meeting with leadership, product and US operations.

Performance: set and report KPIs, including OTIF, stock availability, inventory health and supplier performance.



You must have



8+ years in supply chain, including at least 2 years as the most senior supply chain person at a growing consumer brand.

A track record of building supply chain systems and processes from scratch, not just maintaining existing ones.

Built component (BOM) planning for assembled products yourself, from forecast through to POs.

Hands-on experience with suppliers in China and international freight.

Built forward inventory spend plans for finance.

Experience managing at least one direct report.

Strong modelling in Excel or Google Sheets, and experience with an inventory or ERP system (Cin7, NetSuite, SAP or similar).

Comfortable in a lean team: you take ownership, follow through without chasing and flag problems early.

Clear written and spoken English. You’ll work directly with leadership and suppliers.

Able to work at least 6 hours a day within Sydney business hours (roughly 6am–2pm PHT).



Nice to have



Cin7 experience.

Experience with Amazon or US retail (e.g. Target).

Experience working with contract manufacturers or co-packers.



What we offer



A full-time, long-term role with real ownership of a core part of the business.

The chance to build the supply chain function as we grow.

You’re judged on results, not hours, and there’s no time tracking.

Direct access to the founder and leadership team.



How to apply

Start your application with the words “Deep Roots” so we know you’ve read this ad. We won’t review applications without them. Then include:



Your CV and a short summary of the most senior supply chain role you’ve held: company size, who you reported to, and what you were responsible for.

A short answer (3–5 sentences) to this question: “Tell us about a supply chain system or process you built from scratch. What problem did it solve, and what changed as a result?”

Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date.

title: Heir Outreach Specialist — Remote Phone Role (No Sales, No Commission)
description:
Heir Outreach Specialist — Remote Phone Role (No Sales, No Commission)



JABO REI · Remote, Philippines



Most calling jobs pay you for what you get from a conversation. This one pays you for what you understand.



People tell you things. Colleagues confide in you who confide in no one else. You listened in a way that made them keep going — and you noticed the sentence that mattered. We are hiring that person.



Our terms, first



1. You will never sell. No pitch. No figure. No offer — on any call. A separate team d
 offers later.

2. You will not earn commission. Pay is $5 per hour — no commission, none. If commission is how you motivate yourself, this role will not suit you.

3. Your calls will be recorded and graded — on how well you listened, not what you extracted. Not surveillance — how we tell listening from performing.

4. You will speak less than a third of the time. The heir talks 70% or more. You are capped at 30%.



If those terms read as a relief rather than a loss, keep reading.



The work



JABO REI buys inherited Florida houses with complicated title. Every file contains a question the paperwork cannot answer.



Picture one: a house shared by five siblings. Taxes years behind. A father dead a decade, an estate never opened in court. The documents tell you what. They never tell you why — why a family has left its largest asset untouched ten years.



You make our first contact with that family — and someone in it knows why. No letter or
 goes ahead of you; yours is the first voice heard. Researchers have assembled the family tree and the taxes owed. The facts are in front of you. The story behind them is missing, and only listening reaches it.



The three levels



We grade how far down you go.



- Level 1 — the reason given. "We just haven't gotten around to it." True, and nearly useless.

- Level 2 — the cause. What has made it hard to get around to? "My brother won't return my calls." You reach this on every call.

- Level 3 — the root. Why won't he? Perhaps he lived in the house, cared for their mother, and believes it is his. You reach it most of the time — in the heir's words, never yours.



The skill is not interrogation. It is noticing which sentence opened a door, and making your next question walk through it.



What a great call sounds like



- A real ending. Consent and a specific next step — a date and time, or a 24-to-48-hour window. "We'll be in touch" is not an ending.

- Guarded is legitimate. Forcing progress loses a family. A smaller win counts: they believe you are who you say you are, and accept a letter or callback.

- Notes that hold. The file tells the family's whole story, including the parts that complicate it.



Both people hang up with something. The heir feels heard, for the first time since this began. You hang up with the whole story.



Who this is not built for



- Closers. Steering toward yes is antithetical to this work.

- Script readers. The call opens and closes to a standard. The middle has no script.

- Talkers. The real answer often arrives just after a silence a talker would have filled.

- Quota grinders. Output here is counted in quality conversations, never dial attempts — and depth is not length: a short call that reaches the root outranks a long one that stays on the surface.



On our evidence, sales habits work against this job; our process reveals them.



Who it is built for



The people who thrive here come from patient navigation, hospice and home-care coordination, case management, funeral-service or legal intake, loss mitigation and escalations. If you have spent years helping people through hard moments on the phone, this will feel familiar.



Silence does not unsettle you. A painful story does not send you reaching for comfortable phrases. You want the account, not the convenient one. In most rooms, you noticed what everyone else missed.



Day to day



- Calling heirs from researched files during U.S. calling hours — overnight in the Philippines.

- Callbacks at the time you promised.

- Hours start at four a day and grow with closed deals — five after the first close, six after the second — on a full-time track.

- English C1 or higher: fluent, warm, unhurried. Quiet room, reliable internet, good headset.



We provide the researched file, training in listening and mirroring, and graded feedback on recordings.



How we hire



1. Application. One question, answered inside your OnlineJobs.ph application: Describe a conversation in which your listening changed the outcome. What did you hear, what did you do with it — and what did you deliberately leave unsaid? No template answers it.

2. A packet and two timed tests. If your application lands, you receive a personal link: upload your résumé; take the DISC test at 
/disc-personality-test and upload a screenshot of your results — any other test's results, Tony Robbins included, will not be considered. Then timed tests: an aptitude test, and the Curiosity Test — fragments of real conversations; you choose the next question. The clock is short, so the thinking is your own.

3. A video. If your scores advance you: a video, three to five minutes, one take — why this role, what you bring, your superpower. We listen for how you sound, unscripted — this job is a voice on a phone.

4. An interview. A conversation about your experience, and what your results showed.

5. A live roleplay call with a guarded heir, graded exactly as real calls are: depth, doorways, talk ratio, and the ending.



If you are wondering what happened between that brother and his mother, this role was built for you.



To apply: Use this posting's apply button, and answer the one question above in your application.

title: Root-Cause Investigator — Deal-File Progression & Review
description:
Root-Cause Investigator — Deal-File Progression & Review



JABO REI · Remote, Philippines · Hourly



You have read this file before.



The summary is tidy, the figures agree, everything is marked ready. Halfway down the second page, a cold sentence forms in your head: that doesn't make sense.



Most workplaces teach you to swallow that sentence. Here it is the work product: write it — and prove it — before anyone acts.



The standard, first



1. Instructions are questioned, not merely executed. Some directions you receive will be wrong. Following a flawed instruction is a failure in this seat.

2. A plausible explanation is never the answer. It is the first draft of one.

3. Your reasoning will be examined. Judgment that cannot be shown cannot be trusted.

4. No checklist is long enough. If you need one to know what deserves your attention next, this seat will starve you.

5. Your questions can stop a file. Your question holds the file until the VP of Operations rules on it.



If those lines felt like relief, keep going. This seat is built for someone looking for a problem.



The work



JABO REI buys inherited Florida houses with complicated title: deceased owners, divided heirs, defects in the chain. Researchers build each file. A transaction-coordination team carries it to closing. Automation handles mechanical QA. What no machine provides is an intelligent opponent — this seat.



Movement. You know what each file waits on, who owes the next move, how long it has waited, and which deadline breaks first. You chase every outside party early, so escalation stays a choice.



Judgment. You are the team's questioner. Before a packet leaves or an instruction is followed, you read it adversarially: Does this make sense? What are we missing? How would this fail? You run the pre-mortem nobody scheduled. Money, law, and ambiguity go to our VP of Operations, whose decision is final. Your job is the right question in front of her before the wrong action reaches a file.



The depth standard



Three files stall in one week: the attorney's office is slow; an heir has not returned a signature; the title company asked for "something else."



Level 1 records three delays. True, and nearly useless.



Level 2 opens them. The attorney's office is waiting on a corrected document. The heir has not signed because her packet names a document she doesn't recognize. The title company's "something else" is that same document, under its proper name.



Level 3 sees three symptoms of one cause: a document labeled inconsistently for three weeks — one habit. Then it asks the second-order question: which files have not stalled yet but carry the same label? You return with the root, the pattern, and the files at risk.



That moment — three excuses collapsing into one answer — is what this job pays for. Level 2 on everything. Level 3 by reflex.



Who this is not built for



- Pure executors. If your instinct on receiving an instruction is to complete it, you will do real damage here.

- Checklist minds. "Does this match the form?" is a question our automation asks.

- Volume processors. Years and files touched are not evidence of judgment. We will ask which files you stopped.

- Conflict-avoiders. If objecting to a confident colleague feels costly, the work will exhaust you.

- The incurious expert. "That's how it's done" carries no authority. Orthodoxy is a headwind, not a credential.

- Framework collectors. Naming root-cause analysis is not doing it.



If this posting felt dense, the files are denser.



Who it is built for



The people who flourish here come from interrogation crafts: underwriting review, internal audit, AML or KYC investigation, claims investigation, due-diligence work. One habit unites them: they read a file and test whether its story holds.



No title, probate, real-estate, or genealogy experience is required, and none is preferred. We will teach the domain; we expect you to outpace the teaching. You will get files, questions, and corrections. When a concept is missing, you go learn it to a level you can defend, unassigned and unchecked. What we cannot teach is the reflex to ask the second question, and the third.



You were the one who found the flaw in the plan everyone approved. You are calm in ambiguity. You write with precision. You would rather be right than agreeable — and you make a challenge land as help.



Day to day



- You report directly to the VP of Operations.

- The aging queue: next actions, waiting-on states, deadlines.

- Reading packets and instructions before the team acts.

- The work is mostly written — findings, questions, escalations. Calls are occasional and institutional: a clerk's office, an attorney's staff, a title company. You will not call families.

- Weekday U.S. mornings; quiet room, reliable internet.

- English C1 or higher: precise, unhurried, clear in writing.



How we hire



1. Application. One question: Describe a time your questioning changed an outcome. Everyone had accepted an explanation, a figure, or instructions. What did you notice that they hadn't — and what did you ask? Answer it inside your OnlineJobs.ph application — without it, you are not reviewed.

2. A packet and two timed tests. Applicants who advance receive a personal link: upload your résumé; take the DISC test at 
/disc-personality-test and upload a screenshot of your results — any other test's results, Tony Robbins included, will not be considered. Then the two tests: an aptitude test and the Curiosity Test.

3. An interview. A live problem-solving conversation about your experience and your results — we work a problem together, and your reasoning is the agenda.



Pay is hourly: $5 per hour.

title: Customs Declarant – EU Import & Export Declarations (Customs Capacity Desk)
description:
Employment type: Part-time, freelance · Hours: about 20 hours per week to start, growing as client work grows · Rate: $4 hour, based on experience and licence



The role

We are looking for a precise customs declarant who prepares complete, correct declarations that our clients can submit with confidence.



Claeritas is a Dutch customs operations and trade compliance desk. We give freight forwarders, importers and customs brokers extra declarant capacity in their own customs system, for peaks, holidays, sickness or vacancies. We prepare; our clients review and submit.



Your first work will mainly be preparing import (IMA) and export (EXA) declarations for the Dutch customs system, in our client’s own customs software.



Hours: about 20 hours per week to start, freelance, remote

Location: remote. Work with clients’ data from outside the EU only under a data processing agreement

Overlap must!: at least 3 hours per working day with Dutch office hours (09:00–17:00 CET)

You report to: the Operations Lead



What you will do

Prepare import and export declarations in the client’s customs system, following the client’s instructions

Check commercial invoices, packing lists, transport documents and certificates of origin against each other before you start

Propose HS codes with a written explanation; the client d
 on the final classification

List missing or inconsistent data and ask the right contact to correct it; never correct the data yourself

Keep the shipment tracker up to date and write a short daily or weekly status per client

Log your time per client and per shipment

Tell us what slows you down, so we can improve the checklist and the work instruction



What you bring

Licensed Customs Broker, or a degree in customs administration

At least 3 years preparing import or export declarations at a customs broker, freight forwarder, courier or importer

You know a commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, air waybill and certificate of origin, and you see when they do not match

Hands-on experience with HS classification, customs value and duty calculation

Excellent written English

Precise work in Excel or Google Sheets; comfortable with customs software and web portals

Reliable internet, a backup connection, a quiet workspace and your own laptop

Discretion with client data



Nice to have

Experience with EU customs declarations, the Union Customs Code or the Dutch customs system (IMA, EXA)

Experience with Incoterms, preferential origin or customs procedure codes

Experience with European clients or time zones

Experience with declarations that need CHED (TRACES), phytosanitary, CITES or excise documents.

Experience with EUDR, CITES, CBAM, NVWA, COI, FLEGT ect



How we work

You work from a written briefing and a checklist. A second person checks every declaration before it goes to the client

You work only through your own personal accounts in the client’s system. No shared logins, no client data in personal

Clients deal with Claeritas, not with you directly

We never submit declarations, never act as customs representative and never give a binding classification. If a question needs a specialist conclusion, you pass it to the Operations Lead

A freelance contract with confidentiality and data protection terms applies from the first paid task



Selection process

Apply with your CV and a short note: which declaration types and customs systems you have worked with, and one example of a declaration you stopped because the documents did not match

A 20-minute video call with the Operations Lead

A paid test task of about 3 hours: prepare the data for one import declaration from a sample shipment set, list the gaps, and write the question to the client



Shortlist. We contract you when the first client for your work has signed



Applications without the short note will not be reviewed.

title: Amazon Catalog Maintenance Assistant
description:
APPLY ONLY IF YOU QUALIFY AS AN EXPERT, NOT A BEGINNER.



About the role



We need someone who can keep a large Amazon catalog clean and fix what breaks, every day, without being told twice.

We are a US-based Amazon agency. Our clients run several hundred SKUs across Seller Central and Vendor Central, in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and Brazil. When a listing suppresses, a variation breaks, or a new SKU needs to go live, you are the person who handles it.



This is a hands-on catalog seat, not a strategy seat. You will be in flat files, case logs and listing backends most of the day. If that sounds tedious, this is not the job. If you find a broken parentage satisfying to fix, keep reading.

What you'll be doing



Listing troubleshooting

• Diagnose and fix suppressed, stranded, and inactive listings

• Resolve flat file errors and failed uploads

• Fix incorrect or missing detail page attributes

• Correct browse nodes and category misplacement

• Investigate and fix detail page content that gets overwritten



Variation and parentage work

• Create parent-child variations with the correct variation theme

• Add children to existing live parents without wiping parent data

• Remove a single child from a variation family without breaking the rest

• Split, rebuild, and re-parent broken variation families

• Preserve reviews and rank when restructuring



Listing merges and duplicates

• Merge duplicate ASINs into a single detail page

• Identify and resolve duplicate listings created by catalog conflicts

• Handle GTIN, UPC, and EAN corrections



New listing creation

• Build new listings from supplier data and spec sheets

• Bulk upload via flat files for multi-SKU launches

• Create and maintain listings across the US, Canada, Mexico, and Brazil marketplaces

• Set up backend attributes, search terms, and compliance fields once you are trained on our standard



Case and escalation management

• Open, track, and escalate Seller Support cases to resolution

• Write clear, specific case notes that get results on the first reply

• Follow up on open cases daily rather than letting them sit



Catalog audits and maintenance

• Run routine audits for data accuracy across the catalog

• Monitor account health and flag risks before they become suspensions

• Track inventory status and flag stranded or at-risk SKUs

• Maintain SKU records and documentation in 



Reporting

• Daily end-of-shift summary of what was completed, what is pending, what is blocked

• Flag anything you cannot resolve rather than guessing or letting it sit



Vendor Central

Our largest account is on Vendor Central, so a meaningful share of your day will be there.

Vendor Central experience is preferred but not required. If you are strong on Seller Central and have never touched VC, say so honestly in your application. We will teach it. What we will not do is train someone who claims VC experience they do not have, so be straight about where you are starting from.



On the VC side you would be working with:

• Item setup and catalog updates through Vendor Central

• Detail page and content updates

• Opening and escalating VC cases

Chargebacks, shortage claims, and purchase order issues sit with someone else for now. We may train you on them down the road.



Requirements



Experience

• 3 to 5 years of hands-on Amazon catalog work, minimum. Not 3 to 5 years adjacent to Amazon, and not years spent managing people who did the work

• Seller Central required

• Vendor Central preferred, but we will teach it



Hard skills

• Flat files: you know the difference between Update and PartialUpdate and what happens when you use the wrong one

• Parent-child variation management, including surgical changes to a live family

• Seller Support case handling and escalation

• Suppressed, stranded, and inactive listing resolution

• Image and A+ Content upload

• Excel and Google Sheets at a working level (filtering, lookups, cleaning supplier data for bulk uploads)

How you work

• You escalate when you are unsure instead of guessing on a live listing

• You tell us when something is broken, including when you broke it. You stay calm when a listing goes down on a deadline

• Fluent English, written and spoken. You write clearly enough that a Seller Support case or client-facing report needs light editing, not a rewrite



Logistics

• Reliable computer and backup internet

• Able to work a fixed shift, overnight if you are in Asia

• Comfortable with time tracking and an NDA



Nice to have

None of these are dealbreakers, but they move you up the list:

• Helium 10, DataDive, or similar keyword and listing tools

• Brand Registry work: brand name changes, trademark conflicts, merge issues

• Ungating and category approvals

• Account reinstatement and Plan of Action writing

• FBA shipment plan creation and reimbursement claims

• Experience with non-US Amazon marketplaces (Canada, Mexico, Brazil)

• 
, Asana, or similar project tracking



How we work



Schedule

Full time, 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM US Eastern (8:00 PM to 4:00 AM Philippine time) if needed more on occasion we will let you know



Exclusivity

 No side accounts, no stacked contracts



Engagement

Independent contractor. W-8BEN required. NDA before account access



Compensation

Based on experience. Reviewed at six months, with a check-in around month four



Tools

Hubstaff, 
, Helium 10, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams



Location

Remote. Philippines preferred



You will work across more than one account. One takes the bulk of the day and the other is lighter. We like our people seeing more than one brand because you learn faster and the work stays interesting.



Before you apply

Read this part carefully.

If you do not have the hands-on experience described above, please do not apply. We are not looking for someone to train from zero, and we are not interested in finding out on a call that the resume was optimistic.

If you have genuinely done the work, you will enjoy this interview. Apply.



APPLY ONLY IF YOU QUALIFY AS AN EXPERT, NOT A BEGINNER.

title: People Operations & Compliance Coordinator — U.S. Delivery Operations
description:
# People Operations & Compliance Coordinator — U.S. Delivery Operations



**Company:** Zahyoh

**Schedule:** U.S. Eastern business hours, requiring overnight availability in the Philippines. Scheduled weekend coverage may be required.



## About the role



Zahyoh operates delivery teams serving New York City. We are seeking an organized, dependable coordinator to manage walker onboarding, lead employee calls, investigate delivery issues, and coordinate performance and employee-case follow-up.

- Coordinate corrective actions with Dispatch and the fleet team.

- Coordinate workers’ compensation paperwork, employee injury reports, and administrative follow-up on vehicle a
.

- Strong investigation, spreadsheet, documentation, and follow-up skills.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and a quiet environment for calls.

Submit your résumé and brief answers to these questions:

ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a creative professional who can turn phone-recorded voice notes, singing, songs, and spoken audio into polished animated videos and short films.



For example, we may send a phone recording of someone telling a story or a child singing. You would improve the audio, develop a visual concept, create the animation, and prepare the finished content for approved social media channels.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Clean and enhance phone recordings by reducing background noise, balancing volume, improving vocal clarity, and applying appropriate mixing and mastering.

• Preserve the speaker’s or singer’s natural voice while making the recording sound as clear and professional as the source allows.

• Create storyboards, characters, animated scenes, and lip-sync animation where appropriate.

• Add properly licensed music, sound effects, captions, and other supporting elements.

• Produce animated shorts, music videos, and storytelling content.

• Format videos for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and
 as appropriate.

• Prepare titles, captions, thumbnails, and posting schedules.

• Publish approved content through company-authorized accounts.

• Organize and deliver finished exports, editable project files, and audio stems.



REQUIREMENTS



• A portfolio demonstrating animation and storytelling ability.

• Before-and-after examples of audio cleanup, preferably using phone recordings.

• Experience editing spoken audio and singing vocals.

• Ability to explain what can realistically be improved and when a recording needs to be redone.

• Experience preparing and publishing content across social media platforms.

• Reliable communication, organized file management, and consistent turnaround times.

• Respect for confidentiality, intellectual property, and the privacy of family and children’s content.



AI-assisted tools may be used only with prior approval and must be disclosed. Private recordings, voices, images, and company materials may not be uploaded to unapproved AI services or used for voice cloning or model training.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND OWNERSHIP



The selected contractor must sign an agreement covering confidentiality, intellectual property ownership, account security, and handling of private recordings before receiving sensitive files or account access.



Commissioned deliverables must be assigned to our company under that agreement. Any third-party assets must be disclosed and properly licensed. Content may not be reused, shared, published in a portfolio, or subcontracted without written permission.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A brief introduction describing your strongest skills.

2. Two or three relevant animation samples, identifying your contribution.

3. At least one before-and-after audio restoration example.

4. The animation, audio, and AI tools you use.

5. Your rate and estimated turnaround for a 30–60-second animated video using a supplied phone recording.

6. Your availability and whether you personally handle audio, animation, and publishing.



Shortlisted applicants will be offered a small paid trial using a non-sensitive recording.



Begin your application with “Audio to Animation.”

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Growing Jewelry & Luxury Watch Brand — Long-Term Position
description:
I’m the owner of a growing jewelry and luxury watch business, and I’m looking for a talented, reliable, and motivated short-form video editor to join my team for the long term.



My content revolves around luxury watches, jewelry, real-world negotiations, entertaining interactions, business deals, and behind-the-scenes footage. The goal is to build a recognizable personal brand across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



I’m not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together. I’m looking for someone who understands how to capture attention, keep viewers watching, create engaging content, and help a brand grow.



My goal is to find someone I can build a long-term working relationship with, not someone I have to constantly chase, supervise, or replace.



Responsibilities



• Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

• Create engaging edits with strong hooks, clean cuts, well-timed captions, sound effects, zooms, transitions, and pacing.

• Understand how to maintain viewer attention and eliminate unnecessary pauses or boring sections.

• **Follow the style and direction of my brand while bringing your own creative ideas to the table.**

• Deliver consistent, high-quality work on agreed-upon deadlines.

• Communicate clearly about progress, questions, revisions, and any potential delays.

• Stay organized with project files, footage, revisions, and completed videos.

• Learn my preferences over time so the editing process becomes faster, smoother, and more efficient.

• Be proactive about suggesting improvements to the content rather than waiting for instructions on every little detail.



Experience editing luxury watches, jewelry, negotiations, interviews, podcasts, or personal-brand content is a plus, but strong editing skills and the right attitude matter most.



Requirements — Please Read Carefully



I’m looking for someone who takes their work seriously and can be counted on consistently.



1. Reliable computer and equipment



You must have a capable, relatively modern computer or laptop that can comfortably handle short-form video editing. You should be able to edit footage smoothly without constant freezing, crashing, or excessive rendering delays.



Please disclose your computer’s specifications, including processor, RAM, storage, and graphics capabilities if applicable.



A modern smartphone is also preferred for reviewing content, communicating, and checking how videos look on mobile platforms.



2. Reliable electricity and internet



You must have a dependable electricity supply and stable internet connection that allow you to work consistently.



Because this is a long-term position with deadlines, I need someone who has a realistic plan for handling occasional power interruptions or internet outages. A backup power source, such as a UPS or power station, and backup internet through mobile data or another provider are strong advantages.



Occasional outages can happen anywhere. What matters is that you have the infrastructure, preparation, and communication skills to minimize disruptions and meet commitments.



3. Excellent English communication



You must be comfortable communicating in English, both in writing and in conversation when needed.



You should understand instructions, ask questions when something is unclear, explain challenges professionally, and communicate without me having to repeatedly follow up.



4. Consistency and accountability



I need someone dependable who shows up, meets deadlines, responds to messages within a reasonable timeframe during agreed working hours, and takes ownership of their responsibilities.



If you encounter a problem, communicate early rather than disappearing or waiting until a deadline has passed.



5. A strong work ethic



I’m looking for someone motivated to improve, learn my style, and grow alongside the business. I value initiative, honesty, attention to detail, and a willingness to put in consistent effort.





I don’t expect perfection on day one.

I also like people with good music taste :)

title: Amazon Account Specialist – Seller Central
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Position



We are a growing U.S.-based Amazon agency managing approximately 100 brands across a wide range of product categories. We are looking for an experienced Amazon Account Specialist to join our remote team and help manage the day-to-day execution of our clients' Amazon accounts.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who already understands Amazon Seller Central, can work independently, and is comfortable identifying and solving problems inside active Amazon accounts.



What You'll Do



You will work alongside Account Managers and other Amazon specialists to help manage client accounts, including:



Creating and optimizing Amazon listings

Updating titles, bullets, descriptions, backend keywords, images, and A+ Content

Managing variations and parent/child relationships

Troubleshooting suppressed, stranded, inactive, and restricted listings

Opening and managing Seller Support cases through resolution

Monitoring Account Health and identifying issues that need attention

Reviewing FBA inventory and helping with replenishment recommendations

Troubleshooting FBA receiving and inventory discrepancies

Managing coupons, promotions, deals, and other Seller Central programs

Performing keyword, competitor, category, and listing research

Reviewing accounts for opportunities and problems

Coordinating tasks with advertising, inventory, catalog, and creative team members

Keeping tasks organized and updated

Following up until issues are actually resolved



For us, "done" means the change is live and correct on Amazon, not simply that a case was opened or a task was submitted.



What We're Looking For



You should have 2+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience and be comfortable navigating Seller Central without extensive training.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



Amazon Seller Central

Listing creation and optimization

Catalog troubleshooting

Variations

FBA

Inventory management

Account Health

Seller Support cases

A+ Content and Brand Registry

Promotions and coupons

Amazon reports and business data

Basic Amazon PPC knowledge



You do not need to be a dedicated PPC specialist, but you should understand concepts such as ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, Sponsored Products, keywords, bids, and search terms.



Who We're Looking For



We care as much about how you work as what you already know.



You should be:



Proactive. You notice problems and opportunities instead of waiting for someone to assign every task.

Detail-oriented. Small Amazon mistakes can have large consequences.

Resourceful. You research problems, work through Seller Support, and keep pushing until you find a solution.

Responsive. You communicate promptly and don't leave teammates or clients waiting.

Accountable. If you own something, you follow it through to completion.

Organized. You'll be working across multiple brands and priorities.

A strong written communicator. Clear English communication is important.

Comfortable with feedback. We move quickly and continuously improve our processes.

About the Role



We are a small but growing remote team, so this isn't a corporate environment where you only handle one narrow task.



You'll get exposure to many different Amazon businesses, categories, and problems. Strong performers will have opportunities to take on more account ownership and responsibility over time.



We value people who take ownership, solve problems, communicate well, and make the rest of the team better.



Schedule



This is a full-time, long-term remote position.



We offer flexibility in working hours, but you should generally be available for 1–3 hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time for team communication and meetings.



How to Apply



Please answer the following:



How many years have you worked directly in Amazon Seller Central?

What were your primary responsibilities?

Approximately how many Amazon accounts have you managed or supported?

Describe one difficult Amazon catalog, FBA, or account issue you personally solved. What was the problem, and what did you do?

Which area are you strongest in: catalog/listings, inventory/FBA, account health, PPC, or general account management?

What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



Please begin your application with the words "SELLER CENTRAL" so we know you read the entire posting.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and the opportunity to grow with the team.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: Relevant minimum 3 YEARS of experience working for an MSP

• REQUIRED: With AT LEAST 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role.

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

• REQUIRED: Experience working with an RMM and PSA software (DATTO preferred)

• Preferred: Cyber Security education/experience

• Preferred: Hyper-V experience



Other tools we use:

Barracuda DNS filter, AutoElevate, Cylance, Infocyte, Syxsense, IT Glue, SonicWall, Unifi, and more



HOW TO APPLY?



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line "L2 Tech Support - August 2026".



In your
